  13 |     {
  14 |         try {
  15 |             $startOfCurrentMonth = \Carbon\Carbon::now()->startOfMonth();

  17 |             // Auto-archive cases from prior months that have not been modified or restored during the current month

 366 |     public function update(Request $request, $id)
 367 |     {
 368 |         Log::info('Updating Case:', $request->all());
 369 | 
 370 |         try {
 371 |             $case = LuponCase::find($id);
 372 |             if (!$case || !\App\Http\Controllers\DocumentController::canUserAccessCase($case)) {
 373 |                 AuditService::log(
 374 |                     'UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS',
 375 |                     'Cases',
 376 |                     "Unauthorized modification attempt for Case #{$id} by User #" . (auth()->id() ?? 'Guest'),
 377 |                     $id
 378 |                 );
 379 |                 if ($request->expectsJson()) {
 380 |                     return response()->json(['error' => 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to access this case.'], 403);
 381 |                 }
 382 |                 return redirect()->route('cases.index')->with('error', 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to access this case.');
 383 |             }
 384 | 
 385 |             // Update fields if present (allow partial updates)
 386 |             if ($request->has('case_no')) {
 387 |                 $case->case_number = $request->case_no;
 388 |             }
 389 | 
 390 |             if ($request->has('complainant')) {
 391 |                 $case->complainant = $request->complainant;
 392 |             }
 393 |             if ($request->has('respondent')) {
 394 |                 $case->respondent = $request->respondent;
 395 |             }
 396 | 
 397 |             // Sync title if either party changes
 398 |             if ($request->has('complainant') || $request->has('respondent')) {
 399 |                 $comp = $request->complainant ?? $case->complainant ?? explode(' vs ', $case->title)[0];
 400 |                 $resp = $request->respondent ?? $case->respondent ?? explode(' vs ', $case->title)[1] ?? 'Unknown';
 401 |                 $case->title = $comp.' vs '.$resp;
 402 |             }
 403 | 
 404 |             if ($request->has('narrative')) {
 405 |                 $case->complaint_narrative = $request->narrative;
 406 |             }
 407 |             if ($request->has('date_filed')) {
 408 |                 $case->date_filed = $request->date_filed;
 409 |             }
 410 |             if ($request->has('status')) {
 411 |                 $case->status = $request->status;
 412 |             }
 413 | 
 414 |             // Update document data (layout overrides, new values)
 415 |             // We only want to overwrite document_data if all fields are actually being sent, 
 416 |             // but we can leave the original logic. To be safe, let's only do it if document_type is present.
 417 |             if ($request->has('document_type')) {
 418 |                 $case->document_data = $request->all();
 419 |             }
 420 |             $case->save();
 421 | 
 422 |             // Sync and record version snapshot for attached Document
 423 |             $docType = $request->input('document_type') ?? $case->nature_of_case ?? 'complaint';
 424 |             $doc = $case->documents()->where('type', $docType)->latest()->first() 
 425 |                 ?: $case->documents()->latest()->first();
 426 | 
 427 |             if ($doc) {
 428 |                 $mergedContent = array_merge($doc->content ?: [], $request->all());
 429 |                 $doc->content = $mergedContent;
 430 |                 $doc->save();
 431 |                 \App\Services\DocumentBackupService::recordVersion($doc, 'edited', 'Updated via Case Management');
 432 |             } else {
 433 |                 $folderName = $case->folder_name ?: ('case-' . str_pad($case->id, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT));
 434 |                 $newDoc = \App\Models\Document::create([
 435 |                     'case_id' => $case->id,
 436 |                     'folder_name' => $folderName,
 437 |                     'type' => $docType,
 438 |                     'status' => 'Issued',
 439 |                     'content' => $request->all(),
 440 |                     'issued_at' => now(),
 441 |                     'created_by' => auth()->id(),
 442 |                 ]);
 443 |                 \App\Services\DocumentBackupService::recordVersion($newDoc, 'created', 'Created via Case Management Update');
 444 |             }
 445 | 
 446 |             AuditService::log('UPDATE', 'Cases', "Updated details for Case #{$case->case_number}", $case->case_number);
 447 | 
 448 |             if ($request->expectsJson()) {
 449 |                 return response()->json(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Case updated successfully.']);
 450 |             }
 451 | 
 452 |             return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Case updated successfully.');
 453 | 
 454 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 455 |             Log::error('Case Update Error: '.$e->getMessage());
 456 | 
 457 |             $isDuplicate = ($e instanceof \Illuminate\Database\QueryException && in_array($e->errorInfo[1] ?? 0, [1062, 19]))
 458 |                 || str_contains($e->getMessage(), '1062 Duplicate entry')
 459 |                 || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'UNIQUE constraint failed');
 460 | 
 461 |             $userMessage = $isDuplicate
 462 |                 ? 'That folder number already exists please change your case folder name / number'
 463 |                 : 'An error has occurred while updating the case. Please reload your page or try again.';

 558 |     public function lookup(Request $request)
 559 |     {
 560 |         try {
 561 |             $search = trim($request->input('search', ''));
 562 | 
 563 |             if (empty($search)) {
 564 |                 return response()->json([]);
 565 |             }
 566 | 
 567 |             $user = auth()->user();
 568 |             $isAdmin = $user && ($user->hasRole('Administrator') || $user->hasRole('Admin') || $user->hasRole('Lupon Secretary') || in_array(strtolower($user->role ?? ''), ['administrator', 'admin', 'lupon secretary', 'secretary']));
 569 | 
 570 |             $query = LuponCase::withTrashed();
 571 | 
 572 |             if (!$isAdmin && $user) {
 573 |                 $query->where(function ($q) use ($user) {
 574 |                     $q->whereNull('created_by')
 575 |                       ->orWhere('created_by', $user->id)
 576 |                       ->orWhereHas('documents', function ($dq) use ($user) {
 577 |                           $dq->where('created_by', $user->id);
 578 |                       });
 579 |                 });
 580 |             }
 581 | 
 582 |             $isCasSearch = stripos($search, 'cas') === 0;
 583 | 
 584 |             $query->where(function ($q) use ($search, $isCasSearch) {
 585 |                 $q->where('case_number', 'like', "{$search}%")
 586 |                   ->orWhere('case_number', 'like', "%-{$search}%")
 587 |                   ->orWhere('case_number', 'like', "%/{$search}%")
 588 |                   ->orWhere('title', 'like', "%{$search}%")
 589 |                   ->orWhere('complainant', 'like', "%{$search}%")
 590 |                   ->orWhere('respondent', 'like', "%{$search}%");
 591 | 
 592 |                 if ($isCasSearch) {
 593 |                     $q->orWhere('case_number', 'like', "%{$search}%");
 594 |                 } elseif (strlen($search) >= 4 && is_numeric($search)) {
 595 |                     $q->orWhereYear('date_filed', (int) $search);
 596 |                 }
 597 |             });
 598 | 
 599 |             if (!$isCasSearch) {
 600 |                 // Exclude internal timestamped CAS-... placeholders when searching for specific numbers/years like 2026
 601 |                 $query->where('case_number', 'not like', 'CAS-%');
 602 |             }
 603 | 
 604 |             $cases = $query->orderByRaw("CASE 
 605 |                     WHEN case_number LIKE '{$search}%' THEN 1 
 606 |                     WHEN case_number LIKE '%-{$search}%' THEN 2 
 607 |                     ELSE 3 
 608 |                 END")
 609 |                 ->orderBy('date_filed', 'desc')
 610 |                 ->take(10)
 611 |                 ->get(['id', 'case_number', 'title', 'status', 'nature_of_case']);
 612 | 
 613 |             return response()->json($cases);
 614 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 615 |             Log::error('Case lookup error: ' . $e->getMessage());
 616 |             return response()->json([]);
 617 |         }
 618 |     }

  53 |     /**
  54 |      * Programmed automatic folder counter and numbering algorithm (Row 2 capstone revision).
  55 |      * Queries the total existing case folders across cases and documents,
  56 |      * calculates the next sequential index (n + 1), and formats it as case-XXX (zero-padded).
  57 |      */
  58 |     public function getNextAvailableCaseFolderNumber(): string
  59 |     {
  60 |         try {
  61 |             $caseFolders = \App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()
  62 |                 ->whereNotNull('folder_name')
  63 |                 ->where('folder_name', '!=', '')
  64 |                 ->pluck('folder_name')
  65 |                 ->toArray();
  66 | 
  67 |             $docFolders = \App\Models\Document::withTrashed()
  68 |                 ->whereNotNull('folder_name')
  69 |                 ->where('folder_name', '!=', '')
  70 |                 ->pluck('folder_name')
  71 |                 ->toArray();
  72 | 
  73 |             $allFolders = array_unique(array_filter(array_merge($caseFolders, $docFolders)));
  74 | 
  75 |             $maxIndex = 0;
  76 |             foreach ($allFolders as $folder) {
  77 |                 $folder = trim((string)$folder);
  78 |                 if (preg_match('/(?:case|folder)[-_ ]*0*(\d+)/i', $folder, $matches)) {
  79 |                     $num = (int)$matches[1];
  80 |                     if ($num > $maxIndex) {
  81 |                         $maxIndex = $num;
  82 |                     }
  83 |                 } elseif (preg_match('/^0*(\d+)$/', $folder, $matches)) {
  84 |                     $num = (int)$matches[1];
  85 |                     if ($num > $maxIndex) {
  86 |                         $maxIndex = $num;
  87 |                     }
  88 |                 }
  89 |             }
  90 | 
  91 |             // Calculate next sequential index (n + 1)
  92 |             $nextIndex = max($maxIndex + 1, 1);
  93 |             $candidateFolder = 'case-' . str_pad($nextIndex, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
  94 | 
  95 |             // Double check collision in database (including case-insensitive matches)
  96 |             while (
  97 |                 \App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()->whereRaw('LOWER(folder_name) = ?', [strtolower($candidateFolder)])->exists() ||
  98 |                 \App\Models\Document::withTrashed()->whereRaw('LOWER(folder_name) = ?', [strtolower($candidateFolder)])->exists()
  99 |             ) {
 100 |                 $nextIndex++;
 101 |                 $candidateFolder = 'case-' . str_pad($nextIndex, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
 102 |             }
 103 | 
 104 |             return $candidateFolder;
 105 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 106 |             \Log::error('Error calculating next available folder number: ' . $e->getMessage());
 107 |             $fallbackCount = (\App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()->count() ?: 0) + 1;
 108 |             return 'case-' . str_pad($fallbackCount, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
 109 |         }

 286 |     public function createFolder(Request $request)
 287 |     {
 288 |         if ($this->isAdmin()) {
 289 |             return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'Administrators are in View-Only mode.');
 290 |         }
 291 | 
 292 |         $request->validate([
 293 |             'folder_name' => 'required|string|max:255',
 294 |             'case_number' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
 295 |             'complainant' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
 296 |             'respondent' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
 297 |             'nature_of_case' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
 298 |         ]);
 299 | 
 300 |         $folderName = trim($request->folder_name);
 301 |         $caseNo = trim($request->case_number ?: '');
 302 | 
 303 |         try {
 304 |             // Check if a case or document folder with this name already exists (including soft-deleted records)
 305 |             $folderExistsInCases = \App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()
 306 |                 ->whereRaw('LOWER(folder_name) = ?', [strtolower($folderName)])
 307 |                 ->exists();
 308 | 
 309 |             $folderExistsInDocs = \App\Models\Document::withTrashed()
 310 |                 ->whereRaw('LOWER(folder_name) = ?', [strtolower($folderName)])
 311 |                 ->exists();
 312 | 
 313 |             if ($folderExistsInCases || $folderExistsInDocs) {
 314 |                 $duplicateMsg = 'That folder number already exists please change your case folder name / number';
 315 |                 if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->is('api/*')) {
 316 |                     return response()->json([
 317 |                         'message' => $duplicateMsg,
 318 |                         'errors' => ['folder_name' => [$duplicateMsg]]
 319 |                     ], 422);
 320 |                 }
 321 |                 return redirect()->back()
 322 |                     ->withErrors(['folder_name' => $duplicateMsg])
 323 |                     ->with('error', $duplicateMsg)
 324 |                     ->withInput();
 325 |             }
 326 | 
 327 |             // Check if the provided case number already exists in the system
 328 |             if (!empty($caseNo)) {
 329 |                 $caseExists = \App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()
 330 |                     ->whereRaw('LOWER(case_number) = ?', [strtolower($caseNo)])
 331 |                     ->exists();
 332 | 
 333 |                 if ($caseExists) {
 334 |                     $duplicateMsg = 'That folder number already exists please change your case folder name / number';
 335 |                     if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->is('api/*')) {
 336 |                         return response()->json([
 337 |                             'message' => $duplicateMsg,
 338 |                             'errors' => ['case_number' => [$duplicateMsg]]
 339 |                         ], 422);
 340 |                     }
 341 |                     return redirect()->back()
 342 |                         ->withErrors(['case_number' => $duplicateMsg])
 343 |                         ->with('error', $duplicateMsg)
 344 |                         ->withInput();
 345 |                 }
 346 |             } else {
 347 |                 $caseNo = 'KP-' . date('Y') . '-' . rand(100, 999);
 348 |                 while (\App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()->where('case_number', $caseNo)->exists()) {
 349 |                     $caseNo = 'KP-' . date('Y') . '-' . rand(1000, 9999);
 350 |                 }
 351 |             }
 352 | 
 353 |             $case = \App\Models\LuponCase::create([
 354 |                 'folder_name' => $folderName,
 355 |                 'case_number' => $caseNo,
 356 |                 'title' => ($request->complainant ?: 'Complainant') . ' vs. ' . ($request->respondent ?: 'Respondent'),
 357 |                 'nature_of_case' => $request->nature_of_case ?: 'Amicable Settlement / Civil',
 358 |                 'complainant' => $request->complainant ?: 'Complainant',
 359 |                 'respondent' => $request->respondent ?: 'Respondent',
 360 |                 'status' => 'Pending',
 361 |                 'date_filed' => now()->format('Y-m-d'),
 362 |                 'created_by' => auth()->id(),
 363 |             ]);
 364 | 
 365 |             AuditService::log('CREATE_CASE_FOLDER', 'Document Management', "Created case folder {$folderName}", $case->id);
 366 | 
 367 |             if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->is('api/*')) {
 368 |                 return response()->json([
 369 |                     'success' => true,
 370 |                     'message' => "Case folder {$folderName} created successfully.",
 371 |                     'case' => $case
 372 |                 ]);
 373 |             }
 374 | 
 375 |             return redirect()->back()->with('success', "Case folder {$folderName} created successfully.");
 376 | 
 377 |         } catch (\Illuminate\Database\QueryException $e) {
 378 |             \Log::error('Create folder database error: ' . $e->getMessage());
 379 | 
 380 |             $isDuplicate = ($e->getCode() == 23000 || str_contains($e->getMessage(), '1062') || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'Duplicate entry'));
 381 |             $userFacingMessage = $isDuplicate
 382 |                 ? 'That folder number already exists please change your case folder name / number'
 383 |                 : 'An error has occurred. Please reload your page or try again.';
 384 | 
 385 |             if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->is('api/*')) {
 386 |                 return response()->json([
 387 |                     'message' => $userFacingMessage,
 388 |                     'errors' => ['folder_name' => [$userFacingMessage]]
 389 |                 ], $isDuplicate ? 422 : 500);
 390 |             }
 391 | 
 392 |             return redirect()->back()
 393 |                 ->withErrors([
 394 |                     'folder_name' => $userFacingMessage,
 395 |                     'case_number' => $userFacingMessage,
 396 |                 ])
 397 |                 ->with('error', $userFacingMessage)
 398 |                 ->withInput();
 399 | 
 400 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 401 |             \Log::error('Create folder error: ' . $e->getMessage());
 402 |             $userFacingMessage = 'An error has occurred. Please reload your page or try again.';
 403 | 
 404 |             if ($request->wantsJson() || $request->is('api/*')) {
 405 |                 return response()->json(['message' => $userFacingMessage], 500);
 406 |             }
 407 | 
 408 |             return redirect()->back()
 409 |                 ->withErrors(['general' => $userFacingMessage])
 410 |                 ->with('error', $userFacingMessage)
 411 |                 ->withInput();
 412 |         }

 499 |     public function create($type)
 500 |     {
 501 |         if ($this->isAdmin()) {
 502 |             return redirect()->route('documents.templates')->with('error', 'Administrators are in View-Only mode and cannot open or fill document forms.');
 503 |         }
 504 | 
 505 |         try {
 506 |             // Optional: pre-link to a case when opened via ?case_id=X
 507 |             $caseId = request('case_id');
 508 |             $case = null;
 509 |             if ($caseId) {
 510 |                 $case = \App\Models\LuponCase::find($caseId);
 511 |                 if (!$case || !self::canUserAccessCase($case)) {
 512 |                     return redirect()->route('cases.index')->with('error', 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to access this case.');
 513 |                 }
 514 |             }
 515 | 
 516 |             // Scope caseFolders for dropdown
 517 |             $user = auth()->user();
 518 |             $isAdmin = $user && ($user->hasRole('Administrator') || $user->hasRole('Admin') || $user->hasRole('Lupon Secretary') || in_array(strtolower($user->role ?? ''), ['administrator', 'admin', 'lupon secretary', 'secretary']));
 519 | 
 520 |             $query = \App\Models\LuponCase::query();
 521 |             if (!$isAdmin && $user) {
 522 |                 $query->where(function ($q) use ($user) {
 523 |                     $q->whereNull('created_by')
 524 |                       ->orWhere('created_by', $user->id)
 525 |                       ->orWhereHas('documents', function ($dq) use ($user) {
 526 |                           $dq->where('created_by', $user->id);
 527 |                       });
 528 |                 });
 529 |             }
 530 | 
 531 |             $caseFolders = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get()->map(function ($c) {
 532 |                 return [
 533 |                     'id' => $c->id,
 534 |                     'folder_name' => $c->folder_name ?: ('case-' . str_pad($c->id, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT)),
 535 |                     'complainant' => $c->complainant,
 536 |                     'respondent' => $c->respondent,
 537 |                     'case_number' => $c->case_number,
 538 |                 ];
 539 |             });
 540 | 
 541 |             // Get Layout from DB or Config
 542 |             $savedLayout = FormLayout::where('document_type', $type)->first();
 543 |             if ($savedLayout) {
 544 |                 $fields = $savedLayout->layout_json;
 545 |                 // Merge in any footer fields missing from the saved layout (e.g. new date_split field)
 546 |                 $freshFields = FormLayouts::getLayout($type);
 547 |                 $savedNames = array_column($fields, 'name');
 548 |                 foreach ($freshFields as $ff) {
 549 |                     if (!in_array($ff['name'], $savedNames)) {
 550 |                         $fields[] = $ff;
 551 |                     }
 552 |                 }
 553 |             } else {
 554 |                 $fields = FormLayouts::getLayout($type);
 555 |             }
 556 | 
 557 |             // Pre-fill complainant/respondent from case if available
 558 |             if ($case) {
 559 |                 foreach ($fields as &$field) {
 560 |                     if ($field['name'] === 'complainant' && $case->complainant) {
 561 |                         $field['default'] = $case->complainant;
 562 |                     }
 563 |                     if ($field['name'] === 'respondent' && $case->respondent) {
 564 |                         $field['default'] = $case->respondent;
 565 |                     }
 566 |                     if ($field['name'] === 'case_no' && $case->case_number) {

 589 |     public function fillCustom($id)
 590 |     {
 591 |         if ($this->isAdmin()) {
 592 |             return redirect()->route('documents.templates')->with('error', 'Administrators are in View-Only mode and cannot open document forms.');
 593 |         }
 594 | 
 595 |         try {
 596 |             $template = \App\Models\Document::find($id);
 597 |             if (!$template) {

 599 |             }

 607 |                     return redirect()->route('cases.index')->with('error', 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to access this case.');
 608 |                 }
 609 |             }
 610 |

 612 |             $fields = $template->content['fields'] ?? [];
 613 |

 627 |                     $field['w'] = '30%';
 628 |                 }

 630 |                     $field['h'] = 'auto';
 631 |                 }
 632 |             }
 633 |             unset($field);
 634 | 
 635 |             // Generate background from uploaded PDF
 636 |             $imageBase64 = $this->generateBackgroundImage($type, storage_path('app/public/'.$template->file_path));

 639 |                 'type' => $type,

 644 |                 'templateId' => $id,

 649 |         }

 651 | 
 652 |     /**
 653 |      * Determine if current user can access/view the given case.
 654 |      */
 655 |     public static function canUserAccessCase($case): bool
 656 |     {
 657 |         $user = auth()->user();
 658 |         if (!$user) {
 659 |             return false;
 660 |         }
 661 | 
 662 |         // Admins and Lupon Secretaries have full access to view all cases
 663 |         $role = strtolower($user->role ?? '');
 664 |         if ($user->hasRole('Administrator') || $user->hasRole('Admin') || $user->hasRole('Lupon Secretary') || 
 665 |             in_array($role, ['administrator', 'admin', 'lupon secretary', 'secretary'])) {
 666 |             return true;
 667 |         }
 668 | 
 669 |         // For Data Encoders / non-admin users: STRICTLY check if user is the creator of the case
 670 |         if ($case->created_by !== null && (int)$case->created_by === (int)$user->id) {
 671 |             return true;
 672 |         }
 673 | 
 674 |         // Check if user created any document in this case
 675 |         if ($case->documents()->where('created_by', $user->id)->exists()) {
 676 |             return true;
 677 |         }
 678 | 
 679 |         return false;
 680 |     }

 682 |     /**
 683 |      * Resolve case model supporting numeric ID, case_number, or encrypted ID.
 684 |      */
 685 |     private function resolveCase($id)
 686 |     {
 687 |         if (is_string($id) && strlen($id) > 20) {
 688 |             try {
 689 |                 $id = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Crypt::decryptString($id);
 690 |             } catch (\Exception $e) {
 691 |                 // Not an encrypted payload
 692 |             }
 693 |         }
 694 | 
 695 |         return \App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()
 696 |             ->where('id', $id)
 697 |             ->orWhere('case_number', $id)
 698 |             ->first();
 699 |     }

 701 |     public function show($id)
 702 |     {
 703 |         try {
 704 |             $document = \App\Models\Document::with(['case', 'creator'])->find($id);
 705 |             if (!$document || ($document->case && !self::canUserAccessCase($document->case))) {
 706 |                 \App\Services\AuditService::log(
 707 |                     'UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS', 
 708 |                     'Documents', 
 709 |                     "Unauthorized URL access attempt for Document #{$id} by User #" . (auth()->id() ?? 'Guest'), 
 710 |                     $id
 711 |                 );
 712 |                 return redirect()->route('cases.index')->with('error', 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to access this case.');
 713 |             }
 714 | 
 715 |             $data = $document->content ?? [];
 716 |             $type = $document->type;
 717 |             $case = $document->case;
 718 | 
 719 |             // If the document is linked to a case, merge with case's document_data so all fields are available
 720 |             if ($case && is_array($case->document_data)) {
 721 |                 $data = array_merge($case->document_data, $data);
 722 |             }
 723 |             if (empty($data['narrative']) && !empty($data['body_text'])) {
 724 |                 $data['narrative'] = $data['body_text'];
 725 |             }
 726 |             if (empty($data['For']) && !empty($data['nature_of_case'])) {
 727 |                 $data['For'] = $data['nature_of_case'];
 728 |             }
 729 | 
 730 |             // I-log sa Audit Trail kapag binuksan ang dokumento
 731 |             $sessionKey = 'viewed_document_' . $id;
 732 |             if (!session()->has($sessionKey)) {
 733 |                 \App\Services\AuditService::log(
 734 |                     'READ', 
 735 |                     'Documents', 
 736 |                     "Viewed Document ({$type})" . ($case ? " for Case #{$case->case_number}" : ""), 
 737 |                     $document->id
 738 |                 );
 739 |                 session()->put($sessionKey, true);
 740 |             }

 743 |             $savedLayout = FormLayout::where('document_type', $type)->first();

1241 |     /**
1242 |      * Save calibrated field layout positions for a given document type.
1243 |      * Called from the form-fill calibration panel via AJAX.
1244 |      */
1245 |     public function saveLayout(Request $request)
1246 |     {
1247 |         try {
1248 |             $type = $request->input('document_type');
1249 |         $positions = $request->input('positions'); // array: name → {x, y, w, h}
1250 |         $layout = $request->input('layout');
1251 |         $content = $request->input('content');
1252 |         $caseId = $request->input('case_id') ?: null;
1253 | 
1254 |         if (!$type) {
1255 |             return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid data'], 422);
1256 |         }
1257 | 
1258 |         // Convert layout to positions if it exists (from visual-editor)
1259 |         if (is_array($layout)) {
1260 |             $positions = [];
1261 |             foreach ($layout as $field) {
1262 |                 if (isset($field['name'])) {
1263 |                     $positions[$field['name']] = [
1264 |                         'x' => $field['x'] ?? '0%',
1265 |                         'y' => $field['y'] ?? '0%',
1266 |                         'w' => $field['w'] ?? '10%',
1267 |                         'h' => $field['h'] ?? 'auto',
1268 |                         'class' => $field['class'] ?? '',
1269 |                         'type' => $field['type'] ?? 'text',
1270 |                         'default' => $field['default'] ?? '',

1493 |     /**
1494 |      * Resolve the Ghostscript executable path dynamically.
1495 |      */
1496 |     private function getGhostscriptPath(): string
1497 |     {
1498 |         $gsPath = env('GHOSTSCRIPT_PATH');
1499 |         if ($gsPath) {
1500 |             return $gsPath;
1501 |         }
1502 | 
1503 |         // Try to auto-detect in standard C:\Program Files\gs directory
1504 |         $gsDir = 'C:\\Program Files\\gs';
1505 |         if (is_dir($gsDir)) {
1506 |             $folders = scandir($gsDir);
1507 |             if (is_array($folders)) {
1508 |                 // Sort descending so newer versions are checked first
1509 |                 rsort($folders);
1510 |                 foreach ($folders as $folder) {
1511 |                     if (str_starts_with($folder, 'gs')) {
1512 |                         $candidate = "{$gsDir}\\{$folder}\\bin\\gswin64c.exe";
1513 |                         if (file_exists($candidate)) {
1514 |                             return '"' . $candidate . '"';
1515 |                         }
1516 |                     }
1517 |                 }
1518 |             }
1519 |         }
1520 | 
1521 |         // Fallback to default path or command name if not found/accessible
1522 |         return 'gswin64c';
1523 |     }

1525 |     /**
1526 |      * Use Ghostscript to render page 1 of the form PDF as a base64 PNG.
1527 |      * Returns empty string if GS fails (view shows placeholder instead).
1528 |      */
1529 |     private function generateBackgroundImage(string $type, $customPath = null): string
1530 |     {
1531 |         $pdfPath = $customPath ?? public_path("forms/{$type}.pdf");
1532 |         if (! file_exists($pdfPath)) {
1533 |             $pdfPath = public_path('forms/complaint.pdf');
1534 |         }
1535 | 
1536 |         $outputImage = storage_path('app/public/temp_editor_'.$type.'_'.uniqid().'.png');
1537 |         $gsPath = $this->getGhostscriptPath();
1538 |         $cmd = "{$gsPath} -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -sDEVICE=png16m -r300 -dFirstPage=1 -dLastPage=1"
1539 |                      ." -sOutputFile=\"{$outputImage}\" \"{$pdfPath}\" 2>&1";
1540 | 
1541 |         exec($cmd, $output, $returnCode);
1542 | 
1543 |         if ($returnCode === 0 && file_exists($outputImage)) {
1544 |             $base64 = base64_encode(file_get_contents($outputImage));
1545 |             @unlink($outputImage);
1546 | 
1547 |             return $base64;
1548 |         }
1549 | 
1550 |         \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error('Ghostscript failed for '.$type.': '.implode("\n", $output));
1551 | 
1552 |         return '';
1553 |     }

  10 | class AnalyticsController extends Controller
  11 | {
  12 |     public function index()
  13 |     {
  14 |         try {
  15 |             // 1. Case Growth Rate (Comparing this month vs last month)
  16 |             $thisMonth = LuponCase::whereMonth('date_filed', Carbon::now()->month)
  17 |                 ->whereYear('date_filed', Carbon::now()->year)
  18 |                 ->count();
  19 |             $lastMonth = LuponCase::whereMonth('date_filed', Carbon::now()->subMonth()->month)
  20 |                 ->whereYear('date_filed', Carbon::now()->subMonth()->year)
  21 |                 ->count();
  22 |             
  23 |             $growthRate = $lastMonth > 0 ? (($thisMonth - $lastMonth) / $lastMonth) * 100 : 0;
  24 | 
  25 |             // 2. Average Resolution Time (In days)
  26 |             // We consider 'Resolved' or 'Settled' statuses
  27 |             $resolvedCases = LuponCase::whereIn('status', ['Resolved', 'Settled'])
  28 |                 ->whereNotNull('date_filed')
  29 |                 ->get();
  30 |             
  31 |             $avgDays = 0;
  32 |             if ($resolvedCases->count() > 0) {
  33 |                 $totalDays = $resolvedCases->sum(function($case) {
  34 |                     $filed = Carbon::parse($case->date_filed);
  35 |                     $resolved = Carbon::parse($case->updated_at);
  36 |                     return $filed->diffInDays($resolved);
  37 |                 });
  38 |                 $avgDays = round($totalDays / $resolvedCases->count());
  39 |             }
  40 | 
  41 |             // 3. Settlement Rate
  42 |             $totalCases = LuponCase::count();
  43 |             $settledCases = LuponCase::whereIn('status', ['Resolved', 'Settled'])->count();
  44 |             $settlementRate = $totalCases > 0 ? round(($settledCases / $totalCases) * 100, 1) : 0;
  45 | 
  46 |             // 4. Activity Trends (Monthly)
  47 |             $currentYear = Carbon::now()->year;
  48 |             $monthlyTrends = LuponCase::whereYear('date_filed', $currentYear)
  49 |                 ->selectRaw('MONTH(date_filed) as month, count(*) as total')
  50 |                 ->groupBy('month')
  51 |                 ->orderBy('month')
  52 |                 ->get()
  53 |                 ->map(function($item) {
  54 |                     return [
  55 |                         'name' => Carbon::create()->month($item->month)->format('M'),
  56 |                         'total' => $item->total,
  57 |                     ];
  58 |                 });
  59 | 
  60 |             // 5. Case Type Distribution
  61 |             $typeDistribution = LuponCase::selectRaw('nature_of_case as name, count(*) as value')
  62 |                 ->groupBy('nature_of_case')
  63 |                 ->orderByDesc('value')
  64 |                 ->limit(5)
  65 |                 ->get();
  66 | 
  67 |             // 6. Outcome Distribution
  68 |             $outcomeDistribution = LuponCase::selectRaw('status as name, count(*) as value')
  69 |                 ->groupBy('status')
  70 |                 ->get();
  71 | 
  72 |             return Inertia::render('analytics/index', [
  73 |                 'stats' => [
  74 |                     'growth_rate' => round($growthRate, 1),
  75 |                     'avg_resolution_time' => $avgDays,
  76 |                     'settlement_rate' => $settlementRate,
  77 |                     'active_cases' => LuponCase::where('status', 'Pending')->count(),
  78 |                 ],
  79 |                 'monthlyTrends' => $monthlyTrends,
  80 |                 'typeDistribution' => $typeDistribution,
  81 |                 'outcomeDistribution' => $outcomeDistribution,
  82 |                 'totalCases' => $totalCases,
  83 |             ]);
  84 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
  85 |             \Log::error('Analytics loading failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
  86 |

  88 |                 'stats' => [
  89 |                     'growth_rate' => 0,

 132 |      * Action to update the primary system deadline date.

 134 |     public function updateDeadline(Request $request)
 135 |     {
 136 |         try {
 137 |             $validated = $request->validate([
 138 |                 'deadline_date' => 'required|date_format:Y-m-d',
 139 |             ]);
 140 | 
 141 |             $oldDeadlineStr = SystemSetting::get('ltia_deadline', '2026-09-08');
 142 |             $oldDeadline = Carbon::parse($oldDeadlineStr)->startOfDay();
 143 |             $newDeadline = Carbon::parse($validated['deadline_date'])->startOfDay();
 144 | 
 145 |             $diffInDays = (int) $oldDeadline->diffInDays($newDeadline, false);
 146 | 
 147 |             // Update stored primary deadline
 148 |             SystemSetting::set('ltia_deadline', $validated['deadline_date']);
 149 | 
 150 |             // Automatically shift phase dates if primary deadline changes
 151 |             if ($diffInDays !== 0) {
 152 |                 $phases = LtiaPhase::all();
 153 |                 foreach ($phases as $phase) {
 154 |                     $newStart = Carbon::parse($phase->start_date)->addDays($diffInDays);
 155 |                     $newEnd = Carbon::parse($phase->end_date)->addDays($diffInDays);
 156 | 
 157 |                     $phase->update([
 158 |                         'start_date' => $newStart->format('Y-m-d'),
 159 |                         'end_date' => $newEnd->format('Y-m-d'),
 160 |                     ]);
 161 |                 }
 162 |             }
 163 | 
 164 |             $formatted = $newDeadline->format('F d, Y');
 165 |             AuditService::log('UPDATE', 'LTIA', "Updated primary system deadline to {$formatted}", auth()->id());
 166 | 
 167 |             return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'LTIA system deadline updated & application timeline synchronized.');
 168 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 169 |             \Log::error('Error updating LTIA deadline: ' . $e->getMessage());
 170 |             return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'An error has occurred while updating the deadline. Please reload your page or try again.');

  96 |     private function getEmptyStats()
  97 |     {
  98 |         return [
  99 |             'total_cases' => 0,
 100 |             'cases_this_month' => 0,
 101 |             'pending_cases' => 0,
 102 |             'resolved_cases' => 0,
 103 |             'cases_by_nature' => [],
 104 |             'recent_cases' => [],
 105 |         ];

 107 | 
 108 |     private function getStats($startDate = null, $endDate = null)
 109 |     {
 110 |         try {
 111 |             $query = LuponCase::withTrashed();
 112 | 
 113 |             if (!empty($startDate)) {
 114 |                 $query->whereDate('date_filed', '>=', $startDate);
 115 |             }
 116 |             if (!empty($endDate)) {
 117 |                 $query->whereDate('date_filed', '<=', $endDate);
 118 |             }
 119 | 
 120 |             $cases = $query->get();
 121 | 
 122 |             $nowMonth = Carbon::now()->month;
 123 |             $nowYear = Carbon::now()->year;
 124 | 
 125 |             // Recent cases: Cases filed this month (or sorted recent if custom date filter applied)
 126 |             $thisMonthCases = $cases->filter(function ($c) use ($nowMonth, $nowYear) {
 127 |                 if (!$c->date_filed) return false;
 128 |                 $d = Carbon::parse($c->date_filed);
 129 |                 return $d->month === $nowMonth && $d->year === $nowYear;
 130 |             });
 131 | 
 132 |             // If filtering by specific date range or if no cases this month, fallback to filtered cases set
 133 |             $recentCasesCollection = (!empty($startDate) || !empty($endDate) || $thisMonthCases->isEmpty()) 
 134 |                 ? $cases->sortByDesc('created_at')->take(50)
 135 |                 : $thisMonthCases->sortByDesc('created_at');
 136 | 
 137 |             return [
 138 |                 'total_cases' => $cases->count(),
 139 |                 'cases_this_month' => $cases->filter(function ($c) use ($nowMonth, $nowYear) {
 140 |                     if (!$c->date_filed) return false;
 141 |                     $d = Carbon::parse($c->date_filed);
 142 |                     return $d->month === $nowMonth && $d->year === $nowYear;
 143 |                 })->count(),
 144 |                 'pending_cases' => $cases->whereNotIn('status', ['Resolved', 'Settled', 'Dismissed'])->whereNull('deleted_at')->count(),
 145 |                 'resolved_cases' => $cases->whereIn('status', ['Resolved', 'Settled', 'Dismissed'])->count(),
 146 | 
 147 |                 // Group by Nature
 148 |                 'cases_by_nature' => $cases->groupBy('nature_of_case')->map(function ($group, $key) {
 149 |                     return (object)[
 150 |                         'nature_of_case' => $key ?: 'Unspecified',
 151 |                         'count' => $group->count()
 152 |                     ];
 153 |                 })->values(),
 154 | 
 155 |                 // Recent Cases (Cases filed this month or matching period)
 156 |                 'recent_cases' => $recentCasesCollection->map(function ($case) {
 157 |                         $statusStr = $case->status;
 158 |                         if ($case->trashed()) {
 159 |                             $statusStr = $statusStr ? "{$statusStr} (Archived)" : 'Archived';
 160 |                         }
 161 |                         return [
 162 |                             'id' => $case->id,
 163 |                             'case_number' => $case->case_number,
 164 |                             'title' => $case->title,
 165 |                             'nature' => $case->nature_of_case,
 166 |                             'status' => $statusStr,
 167 |                             'is_archived' => $case->trashed(),
 168 |                             'date_filed' => $case->date_filed ? Carbon::parse($case->date_filed)->format('M d, Y') : 'N/A',
 169 |                         ];
 170 |                     })->values(),
 171 |             ];
 172 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 173 |             \Log::error('Error calculating report stats: ' . $e->getMessage());
 174 |             return $this->getEmptyStats();
 175 |         }
 176 |     }

  84 |     /**
  85 |      * Restore database records from an uploaded backup JSON file.
  86 |      */
  87 |     public function restoreBackup(Request $request)
  88 |     {
  89 |         $validator = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator::make($request->all(), [
  90 |             'backup_file' => 'required|file|max:51200',
  91 |         ], [
  92 |             'backup_file.required' => 'Security rejected: Please select a valid .json system backup package.',
  93 |             'backup_file.file' => 'Security rejected: The uploaded file is invalid.',
  94 |             'backup_file.max' => 'Security rejected: Backup file cannot exceed 50MB.',
  95 |         ]);
  96 | 
  97 |         if ($validator->fails()) {
  98 |             $err = $validator->errors()->first('backup_file');
  99 |             AuditService::log(
 100 |                 'SECURITY_RESTORE_REJECTED',
 101 |                 'System Backup Security',
 102 |                 "Security rejected database restore attempt: {$err}",
 103 |                 null
 104 |             );
 105 |             return redirect()->back()->with('error', $err);
 106 |         }
 107 | 
 108 |         $file = $request->file('backup_file');
 109 |         $fileName = $file->getClientOriginalName();
 110 |         $extension = strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension());
 111 | 
 112 |         if ($extension !== 'json') {
 113 |             AuditService::log(
 114 |                 'SECURITY_RESTORE_REJECTED',
 115 |                 'System Backup Security',
 116 |                 "Security rejected database restore attempt with non-JSON file '{$fileName}'",
 117 |                 null
 118 |             );
 119 |             return redirect()->back()->with('error', "Security rejected: Only .json database backup packages generated by Lupon Tagapamayapa System are accepted. (Received: '{$fileName}')");
 120 |         }
 121 | 
 122 |         try {
 123 |             $content = @file_get_contents($file->getRealPath());
 124 |             $data = @json_decode($content, true);
 125 | 
 126 |             if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE || !is_array($data)) {
 127 |                 AuditService::log(
 128 |                     'SECURITY_RESTORE_REJECTED',
 129 |                     'System Backup Security',
 130 |                     "Security rejected database restore attempt with corrupted JSON file '{$fileName}'",
 131 |                     null
 132 |                 );
 133 |                 return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'Security rejected: File is corrupted or not a valid JSON document.');
 134 |             }
 135 | 
 136 |             // Security Signature Verification: Strictly verify that this file is the one generated by "Create & Download Backup Now"
 137 |             if (
 138 |                 !isset($data['metadata']['system']) ||
 139 |                 $data['metadata']['system'] !== 'Lupon Tagapamayapa System' ||
 140 |                 !isset($data['tables']) ||
 141 |                 !is_array($data['tables'])
 142 |             ) {
 143 |                 AuditService::log(
 144 |                     'SECURITY_RESTORE_REJECTED',
 145 |                     'System Backup Security',
 146 |                     "Security rejected database restore attempt with unrecognized backup package file '{$fileName}'",
 147 |                     null
 148 |                 );
 149 |                 return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'Security rejected: This file is not a recognized Lupon Tagapamayapa system backup package. Only backup files created with "Create & Download Backup Now" can be restored.');
 150 |             }
 151 | 
 152 |             $tables = $data['tables'];
 153 |             $recognizedTables = ['cases', 'documents', 'document_versions', 'system_settings', 'audit_logs'];
 154 |             $hasValidTable = false;
 155 |             foreach ($recognizedTables as $rt) {
 156 |                 if (isset($tables[$rt]) && is_array($tables[$rt])) {
 157 |                     $hasValidTable = true;
 158 |                     break;
 159 |                 }
 160 |             }
 161 | 
 162 |             if (!$hasValidTable) {
 163 |                 AuditService::log(
 164 |                     'SECURITY_RESTORE_REJECTED',
 165 |                     'System Backup Security',
 166 |                     "Security rejected database restore attempt with empty or invalid table structures in '{$fileName}'",
 167 |                     null
 168 |                 );
 169 |                 return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'Security rejected: The backup file does not contain any valid Lupon database records.');
 170 |             }
 171 | 
 172 |             DB::beginTransaction();
 173 | 
 174 |             $tables = $data['tables'];
 175 | 
 176 |             // Restore Cases
 177 |             if (isset($tables['cases']) && is_array($tables['cases'])) {
 178 |                 foreach ($tables['cases'] as $caseRow) {
 179 |                     $id = $caseRow['id'];
 180 |                     unset($caseRow['id']);
 181 |                     LuponCase::withTrashed()->updateOrCreate(['id' => $id], $caseRow);
 182 |                 }
 183 |             }
 184 | 
 185 |             // Restore Documents
 186 |             if (isset($tables['documents']) && is_array($tables['documents'])) {
 187 |                 foreach ($tables['documents'] as $docRow) {
 188 |                     $id = $docRow['id'];
 189 |                     unset($docRow['id']);
 190 |                     Document::withTrashed()->updateOrCreate(['id' => $id], $docRow);
 191 |                 }
 192 |             }
 193 | 
 194 |             // Restore Document Versions
 195 |             if (isset($tables['document_versions']) && is_array($tables['document_versions'])) {
 196 |                 foreach ($tables['document_versions'] as $verRow) {
 197 |                     $id = $verRow['id'];
 198 |                     unset($verRow['id']);
 199 |                     DocumentVersion::updateOrCreate(['id' => $id], $verRow);
 200 |                 }
 201 |             }
 202 | 
 203 |             // Restore System Settings
 204 |             if (isset($tables['system_settings']) && is_array($tables['system_settings'])) {
 205 |                 foreach ($tables['system_settings'] as $settingRow) {
 206 |                     $key = $settingRow['key'];
 207 |                     SystemSetting::set($key, $settingRow['value'] ?? null);
 208 |                 }
 209 |             }
 210 | 
 211 |             DB::commit();
 212 | 
 213 |             AuditService::log(
 214 |                 'FULL_DATABASE_RESTORE',
 215 |                 'System Backup & Restore',
 216 |                 "Restored database records from backup file {$fileName}",
 217 |                 null
 218 |             );
 219 | 
 220 |             return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'Database records restored from backup successfully.');
 221 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 222 |             DB::rollBack();
 223 |             $fileName = isset($fileName) ? $fileName : 'Uploaded File';
 224 |             AuditService::log(
 225 |                 'SECURITY_RESTORE_FAILED',
 226 |                 'System Backup Security',
 227 |                 "Database restore failed for file '{$fileName}': " . $e->getMessage(),
 228 |                 null
 229 |             );
 230 |             Log::error('Full database restore failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
 231 |             return redirect()->back()->with('error', 'An error has occurred while restoring the database records. Please reload your page or try again.');
 232 |         }

  22 |

  28 |                       ->where('action', 'NOT LIKE', '%NOT_FOUND%')
  29 |                       ->where('action', 'NOT LIKE', '%MISMATCH%')

  36 |                       });
  37 |             }

  39 |             $notifications = (clone $query)
  40 |                 ->recent()

  42 |                 ->get();

  10 | use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Request;
  11 | 
  12 | class AuditService
  13 | {
  14 |     public static function log($action, $module, $details, $recordId = null, $userId = null)
  15 |     {
  16 |         $log = AuditLog::create([
  17 |             'user_id' => $userId ?? Auth::id(),
  18 |             'action' => $action,
  19 |             'module' => $module,
  20 |             'record_id' => $recordId,
  21 |             'details' => $details,
  22 |             'ip_address' => Request::ip(),
  23 |             'user_agent' => Request::userAgent(),
  24 |         ]);
  25 | 
  26 |         try {
  27 |             self::createNotificationsFromAudit($log);
  28 |         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
  29 |             Log::error('Failed to create notifications for audit log: ' . $e->getMessage());
  30 |         }
  31 | 
  32 |         return $log;
  33 |     }
  34 | 
  35 |     public static function createNotificationsFromAudit(AuditLog $auditLog)
  36 |     {
  37 |         $title = self::formatTitle($auditLog->action, $auditLog->module);
  38 |         $link = self::determineLink($auditLog->module);
  39 | 
  40 |         $users = User::all();
  41 |         if ($users->isEmpty()) {
  42 |             return;
  43 |         }
  44 | 
  45 |         $now = now();
  46 |         $notifications = [];
  47 | 
  48 |         $isErrorMessage = str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->module), 'system') ||
  49 |                           str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->module), 'kernel') ||
  50 |                           str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->action), 'error') ||
  51 |                           str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->action), 'not_found') ||
  52 |                           str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->action), 'mismatch') ||
  53 |                           str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->action), 'failed') ||
  54 |                           str_contains(strtolower($auditLog->details), 'error type:');
  55 | 
  56 |         foreach ($users as $user) {
  57 |             $userIsAdmin = $user->hasRole('Administrator') || $user->hasRole('Admin') || in_array($user->role, ['Administrator', 'Admin']);
  58 | 
  59 |             // Non-admin users (Data Encoders) will not receive technical error message notifications
  60 |             if (!$userIsAdmin && $isErrorMessage) {
  61 |                 continue;
  62 |             }
  63 | 
  64 |             $notifications[] = [
  65 |                 'user_id' => $user->id,
  66 |                 'audit_log_id' => $auditLog->id,
  67 |                 'title' => $title,
  68 |                 'details' => $auditLog->details,
  69 |                 'module' => $auditLog->module,
  70 |                 'action' => $auditLog->action,
  71 |                 'link' => $link,
  72 |                 'read_at' => null,
  73 |                 'created_at' => $now,
  74 |                 'updated_at' => $now,
  75 |             ];
  76 |         }
  77 | 
  78 |         if (!empty($notifications)) {
  79 |             Notification::insert($notifications);
  80 |         }
  81 |     }
  82 | 
  83 |     private static function formatTitle(string $action, string $module): string
  84 |     {
  85 |         $cleanModule = strtolower($module);
  86 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'case')) {
  87 |             return "Case Event: {$action}";
  88 |         }
  89 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'doc')) {
  90 |             return "Document Event: {$action}";
  91 |         }
  92 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'ltia')) {
  93 |             return "LTIA Update: {$action}";
  94 |         }
  95 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'auth') || str_contains($cleanModule, 'login')) {
  96 |             return "Security Alert: {$action}";
  97 |         }
  98 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'user')) {
  99 |             return "User Management: {$action}";
 100 |         }
 101 | 
 102 |         return "{$module}: {$action}";
 103 |     }
 104 | 
 105 |     private static function determineLink(string $module): string
 106 |     {
 107 |         $cleanModule = strtolower($module);
 108 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'case')) {
 109 |             return '/cases';
 110 |         }
 111 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'doc')) {
 112 |             return '/documents';
 113 |         }
 114 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'ltia')) {
 115 |             return '/ltia';
 116 |         }
 117 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'user')) {
 118 |             return '/users';
 119 |         }
 120 |         if (str_contains($cleanModule, 'auth') || str_contains($cleanModule, 'login') || str_contains($cleanModule, 'security')) {
 121 |             return '/dashboard';
 122 |         }
 123 | 
 124 |         return '/dashboard';
 125 |     }

  12 |      * Create an immutable backup snapshot version for a document.
  13 |      */
  14 |     public static function recordVersion(Document $document, string $changeType = 'edited', ?string $customNote = null): ?DocumentVersion
  15 |     {
  16 |         try {
  17 |             $user = auth()->user();
  18 |             $nextVersionNumber = DocumentVersion::where('document_id', $document->id)->max('version_number') + 1;
  19 | 
  20 |             $version = DocumentVersion::create([
  21 |                 'document_id' => $document->id,
  22 |                 'version_number' => $nextVersionNumber,
  23 |                 'edited_by' => $user ? $user->id : null,
  24 |                 'edited_by_name' => $user ? $user->name : 'System Automated Backup',
  25 |                 'change_type' => $changeType,
  26 |                 'content_snapshot' => $document->content ?: [],
  27 |                 'file_path_snapshot' => $document->file_path,
  28 |                 'ip_address' => request()->ip(),
  29 |                 'user_agent' => request()->userAgent(),
  30 |             ]);
  31 | 
  32 |             // Audit Trail Security Event
  33 |             AuditService::log(
  34 |                 'SECURITY_DOCUMENT_BACKUP',
  35 |                 'Data Integrity & Anti-Tamper',
  36 |                 "Created backup version #{$nextVersionNumber} for document ID #{$document->id} ({$document->type}) - Action: {$changeType}" . ($customNote ? " ({$customNote})" : ""),
  37 |                 $document->id
  38 |             );
  39 | 
  40 |             return $version;
  41 |         } catch (\Exception $e) {
  42 |             Log::error('DocumentBackupService recordVersion failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
  43 |             return null;
  44 |         }
  45 |     }
  46 | 
  47 |     /**
  48 |      * Restore a document to a previous historical version snapshot.
  49 |      */
  50 |     public static function restoreVersion(Document $document, int $versionId): bool
  51 |     {
  52 |         try {
  53 |             $version = DocumentVersion::where('document_id', $document->id)->where('id', $versionId)->first();
  54 |             if (!$version) {
  55 |                 return false;
  56 |             }
  57 | 
  58 |             // Revert document fields
  59 |             $document->content = $version->content_snapshot;
  60 |             if ($version->file_path_snapshot) {
  61 |                 $document->file_path = $version->file_path_snapshot;
  62 |             }
  63 |             $document->save();
  64 | 
  65 |             // Sync restored data back to parent LuponCase if linked
  66 |             if ($document->case_id) {
  67 |                 $case = \App\Models\LuponCase::withTrashed()->find($document->case_id);
  68 |                 if ($case) {
  69 |                     $snapshot = $version->content_snapshot ?: [];
  70 |                     $updated = false;
  71 | 
  72 |                     if (!empty($snapshot['complainant'])) {
  73 |                         $case->complainant = $snapshot['complainant'];
  74 |                         $updated = true;
  75 |                     }
  76 |                     if (!empty($snapshot['respondent'])) {
  77 |                         $case->respondent = $snapshot['respondent'];
  78 |                         $updated = true;
  79 |                     }
  80 |                     if (!empty($snapshot['nature_of_case']) || !empty($snapshot['For'])) {
  81 |                         $case->nature_of_case = $snapshot['nature_of_case'] ?? $snapshot['For'];
  82 |                         $updated = true;
  83 |                     }
  84 |                     if (!empty($snapshot['case_no'])) {
  85 |                         $case->case_number = $snapshot['case_no'];
  86 |                         $updated = true;
  87 |                     }
  88 |                     if (isset($snapshot['summary']) || isset($snapshot['narrative'])) {
  89 |                         $case->complaint_narrative = $snapshot['summary'] ?? $snapshot['narrative'] ?? $case->complaint_narrative;
  90 |                         $updated = true;
  91 |                     }
  92 | 
  93 |                     $case->document_data = $snapshot;
  94 |                     if ($updated) {
  95 |                         $comp = $case->complainant ?? 'Unknown';
  96 |                         $resp = $case->respondent ?? 'Unknown';
  97 |                         $case->title = "{$comp} vs {$resp}";
  98 |                         $case->save();
  99 |                     }
 100 |                 }
 101 |             }
 102 | 
 103 |             // Record a new backup entry for restoration audit trail
 104 |             static::recordVersion($document, 'restored', "Restored back to Version #{$version->version_number}");
 105 | 
 106 |             // Audit Trail Log
 107 |             $user = auth()->user();
 108 |             AuditService::log(
 109 |                 'RESTORE_DOCUMENT_VERSION',
 110 |                 'Data Security & Recovery',
 111 |                 "User " . ($user ? $user->name : 'Admin') . " restored document ID #{$document->id} to version #{$version->version_number}",
 112 |                 $document->id
 113 |             );
 114 | 
 115 |             return true;
 116 |         } catch (\Exception $e) {
 117 |             Log::error('DocumentBackupService restoreVersion failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
 118 |             return false;
 119 |         }
 120 |     }

1856 |     function getOrdinalDay(day) {
1857 |         const d = parseInt(day, 10);
1858 |         if (isNaN(d)) return day;
1859 |         if (d > 3 && d < 21) return d + 'th';
1860 |         switch (d % 10) {
1861 |             case 1:  return d + 'st';
1862 |             case 2:  return d + 'nd';
1863 |             case 3:  return d + 'rd';
1864 |             default: return d + 'th';
1865 |         }
1866 |     }

1868 |     function update12HourTimeField(fieldName) {
1869 |         const hEl = document.getElementById('hearing-hour-' + fieldName);
1870 |         const mEl = document.getElementById('hearing-minute-' + fieldName);
1871 |         const apEl = document.getElementById('hearing-ampm-' + fieldName);
1872 |         const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
1873 |         const displayEl = document.getElementById('hearing-time-display-' + fieldName);
1874 | 
1875 |         if (!hEl || !targetInput) return;
1876 | 
1877 |         const hour = hEl.value;
1878 |         const minute = (mEl && mEl.value !== '') ? mEl.value : '00';
1879 |         const ampm = (apEl && apEl.value) ? apEl.value : 'AM';
1880 | 
1881 |         if (hour) {
1882 |             const formattedTime = hour + ':' + minute + ' ' + ampm;
1883 |             targetInput.value = formattedTime;
1884 |             if (displayEl) {
1885 |                 displayEl.textContent = formattedTime;
1886 |                 displayEl.style.color = '#1d4ed8';
1887 |             }
1888 |         } else {
1889 |             targetInput.value = '';
1890 |             if (displayEl) {
1891 |                 displayEl.textContent = 'Not selected';
1892 |                 displayEl.style.color = '#64748b';
1893 |             }
1894 |         }
1895 | 
1896 |         updatePreview(fieldName, targetInput.value);
1897 |         targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
1898 |     }

1900 |     function updateCombinedHearingDateTime(fieldName) {
1901 |         const dateEl = document.getElementById('date-picker-' + fieldName);
1902 |         const hEl = document.getElementById('time-hour-' + fieldName);
1903 |         const mEl = document.getElementById('time-min-' + fieldName);
1904 |         const apEl = document.getElementById('time-ampm-' + fieldName);
1905 |         const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
1906 |         const displayEl = document.getElementById('date-time-display-' + fieldName);
1907 | 
1908 |         if (!targetInput) return;
1909 | 
1910 |         let dateStr = '';
1911 |         if (dateEl && dateEl.value) {
1912 |             const d = new Date(dateEl.value + 'T00:00:00');
1913 |             if (!isNaN(d)) {
1914 |                 dateStr = MONTH_NAMES[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getDate() + ', ' + d.getFullYear();
1915 |             }
1916 |         }
1917 | 
1918 |         let timeStr = '';
1919 |         if (hEl && hEl.value) {
1920 |             const hour = hEl.value;
1921 |             const minute = (mEl && mEl.value !== '') ? mEl.value : '00';
1922 |             const ampm = (apEl && apEl.value) ? apEl.value : 'AM';
1923 |             timeStr = hour + ':' + minute + ' ' + ampm;
1924 |         }
1925 | 
1926 |         let combined = '';
1927 |         if (dateStr && timeStr) {
1928 |             combined = dateStr + ' at ' + timeStr;
1929 |         } else if (dateStr) {
1930 |             combined = dateStr;
1931 |         } else if (timeStr) {
1932 |             combined = timeStr;
1933 |         }
1934 | 
1935 |         targetInput.value = combined;
1936 |         if (displayEl) {
1937 |             displayEl.textContent = combined || 'Select date & time above';
1938 |             displayEl.style.color = combined ? '#0f172a' : '#64748b';
1939 |         }
1940 | 
1941 |         updatePreview(fieldName, targetInput.value);
1942 |         targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
1943 |     }

1996 |     function initAllHearingControls() {
1997 |         // 1. Initialize dedicated 12-hour time fields
1998 |         document.querySelectorAll('[id^="hearing-hour-"]').forEach(hEl => {
1999 |             const fieldName = hEl.id.replace('hearing-hour-', '');
2000 |             const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
2001 |             if (!targetInput || !targetInput.value.trim()) return;
2002 | 
2003 |             const val = targetInput.value.trim();
2004 |             const mEl = document.getElementById('hearing-minute-' + fieldName);
2005 |             const apEl = document.getElementById('hearing-ampm-' + fieldName);
2006 | 
2007 |             // Pattern A: "9:00 AM", "09:30 PM", "9:00am"
2008 |             let match = val.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)/i);
2009 |             if (match) {
2010 |                 hEl.value = parseInt(match[1], 10);
2011 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = match[2];
2012 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = match[3].toUpperCase();
2013 |                 update12HourTimeField(fieldName);
2014 |                 return;
2015 |             }
2016 | 
2017 |             // Pattern B: "14:30" (24-hour military)
2018 |             match = val.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
2019 |             if (match) {
2020 |                 let h = parseInt(match[1], 10);
2021 |                 const m = match[2];
2022 |                 const ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
2023 |                 h = h % 12 || 12;
2024 |                 hEl.value = h;
2025 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = m;
2026 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = ap;
2027 |                 update12HourTimeField(fieldName);
2028 |                 return;
2029 |             }
2030 | 
2031 |             // Pattern C: "1000", "0900" (4-digit military)
2032 |             match = val.match(/^(\d{2})(\d{2})$/);
2033 |             if (match) {
2034 |                 let h = parseInt(match[1], 10);
2035 |                 const m = match[2];
2036 |                 const ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
2037 |                 h = h % 12 || 12;
2038 |                 hEl.value = h;
2039 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = m;
2040 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = ap;
2041 |                 update12HourTimeField(fieldName);
2042 |                 return;
2043 |             }
2044 |         });
2045 | 
2046 |         // 2. Initialize combined hearing date & time fields
2047 |         document.querySelectorAll('[id^="date-picker-hearing_"], [id^="date-picker-first_session_"], [id^="date-picker-field_"]').forEach(dateEl => {
2048 |             const fieldName = dateEl.id.replace('date-picker-', '');
2049 |             const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
2050 |             if (!targetInput || !targetInput.value.trim()) return;
2051 | 
2052 |             const val = targetInput.value.trim();
2053 |             const hEl = document.getElementById('time-hour-' + fieldName);
2054 |             const mEl = document.getElementById('time-min-' + fieldName);
2055 |             const apEl = document.getElementById('time-ampm-' + fieldName);
2056 | 
2057 |             // Extract time part: "at 9:00 AM" or "9:00 AM"
2058 |             const timeMatch = val.match(/at\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)/i) || val.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)/i);

2069 |                 if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed.getFullYear() > 1900) {

2085 |         if (splitPicker && sMonth && sDay && sYear && sMonth.value && sDay.value) {
2086 |             const mIdx = MONTH_NAMES.findIndex(m => m.toLowerCase() === sMonth.value.trim().toLowerCase());
2087 |             const dNum = parseInt(sDay.value.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);

2183 |                 : 'Are you sure you want to generate & save this document?';

2252 |     function doSaveFormOnly() {
2253 |         const overridesEl = document.getElementById('layout-overrides');
2254 |         if (overridesEl) overridesEl.value = JSON.stringify(buildLayoutOverrides());
2255 | 
2256 |         const actionInput = document.querySelector('input[name="action"]');
2257 |         if (actionInput) actionInput.value = 'save_only';
2258 | 
2259 |         const loader = document.getElementById('loaderOverlay');
2260 |         const loaderText = document.querySelector('.loader-text');
2261 |         if (loader) loader.classList.add('active');
2262 |         if (loaderText) loaderText.innerText = 'Saving...';
2263 | 
2264 |         const form = document.getElementById('doc-form');
2265 |         const formData = new FormData(form);
2266 | 
2267 |         fetch(form.getAttribute('action'), {
2268 |             method: 'POST',
2269 |             body: formData,
2270 |             headers: {
2271 |                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
2272 |             }
2273 |         })
2274 |         .then(response => response.json())
2275 |         .then(data => {
2276 |             if (loader) loader.classList.remove('active');
2277 |             if (loaderText) loaderText.innerText = 'Generating PDF...'; // reset loader text
2278 |             if (data && data.success) {
2279 |                 alert('Success! ' + (data.message || 'Document saved successfully.'));
2280 |                 window.location.href = '/cases';
2281 |             } else {
2282 |                 alert('Error: ' + ((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not save form.'));
2283 |                 if (actionInput) actionInput.value = 'preview'; // restore default
2284 |             }
2285 |         })
2286 |         .catch(err => {
2287 |             if (loader) loader.classList.remove('active');
2288 |             if (loaderText) loaderText.innerText = 'Generating PDF...'; // reset loader text
2289 |             if (actionInput) actionInput.value = 'preview'; // restore default
2290 |             console.error(err);
2291 |             alert('Failed to save document. Please try again.');
2292 |         });
2293 |     }

2344 |     // ============================
2345 |     // DOWNLOAD AS WORD (.docx)
2346 |     // ============================
2347 |     function downloadWord() {
2348 |         const wordForm = document.getElementById('word-form');
2349 | 
2350 |         // Remove any previously injected value inputs
2351 |         wordForm.querySelectorAll('.injected-field').forEach(el => el.remove());
2352 | 
2353 |         // Copy all filled values from the main form into the word-form
2354 |         document.querySelectorAll('#doc-form .form-input, #doc-form .form-textarea').forEach(el => {
2355 |             if (el.name && el.value.trim() !== '') {
2356 |                 const hidden = document.createElement('input');
2357 |                 hidden.type  = 'hidden';
2358 |                 hidden.name  = el.name;
2359 |                 hidden.value = el.value;
2360 |                 hidden.classList.add('injected-field');
2361 |                 wordForm.appendChild(hidden);
2362 |             }
2363 |         });
2364 | 
2365 |         // Copy checked checkboxes
2366 |         document.querySelectorAll('#doc-form input[type="checkbox"]:checked').forEach(cb => {
2367 |             const hidden = document.createElement('input');
2368 |             hidden.type  = 'hidden';
2369 |             hidden.name  = cb.name;
2370 |             hidden.value = cb.value;
2371 |             hidden.classList.add('injected-field');
2372 |             wordForm.appendChild(hidden);
2373 |         });
2374 | 
2375 |         // Submit — browser will prompt to open/save the .docx
2376 |         wordForm.submit();
2377 |     }

2630 | // Undo logic
2631 | function pushCalibState() {
2632 |     let state = [];
2633 |     const paperW = document.getElementById('calibPaper').offsetWidth;
2634 |     const paperH = document.getElementById('calibPaper').offsetHeight;
2635 | 
2636 |     document.querySelectorAll('.calib-field').forEach(el => {
2637 |         let name = el.dataset.name;
2638 |         // Keep precise size state 
2639 |         if (paperW && paperH) {
2640 |              calibPositions[name].w = ((el.offsetWidth / paperW) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2641 |              calibPositions[name].h = ((el.offsetHeight / paperH) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2642 |         }
2643 | 
2644 |         const textEl = el.querySelector('.calib-field-text');
2645 |         state.push({
2646 |             name: name,
2647 |             x: calibPositions[name].x,
2648 |             y: calibPositions[name].y,
2649 |             w: calibPositions[name].w,
2650 |             h: calibPositions[name].h,
2651 |             left: el.style.left,
2652 |             top: el.style.top,
2653 |             width: el.style.width,
2654 |             height: el.style.height,
2655 |             html: textEl ? textEl.innerHTML : '',
2656 |             value: document.getElementById('field-' + name)?.value || ''
2657 |         });
2658 |     });
2659 |     
2660 |     let stateString = JSON.stringify(state);
2661 |     if (calibHistory.length === 0 || JSON.stringify(calibHistory[calibHistory.length - 1]) !== stateString) {
2662 |         calibHistory.push(state);
2663 |     }
2664 | }

2666 | function undoCalibration() {
2667 |     if (calibHistory.length <= 1) return;
2668 |     calibHistory.pop(); // discard current state
2669 |     const prevState = calibHistory[calibHistory.length - 1]; // get previous
2670 |     
2671 |     prevState.forEach(s => {
2672 |         calibPositions[s.name].x = s.x;
2673 |         calibPositions[s.name].y = s.y;
2674 |         calibPositions[s.name].w = s.w;
2675 |         calibPositions[s.name].h = s.h;
2676 |         
2677 |         let el = document.querySelector('.calib-field[data-name="' + s.name + '"]');
2678 |         if (el) {
2679 |             el.style.left = s.x + '%';
2680 |             el.style.top = s.y + '%';
2681 |             el.style.width = s.w;
2682 |             if (s.h && s.h !== 'auto') {
2683 |                 el.style.height = s.h;
2684 |             } else {
2685 |                 el.style.height = 'auto';
2686 |             }
2687 |             
2688 |             const textEl = el.querySelector('.calib-field-text');
2689 |             if (textEl) {
2690 |                 textEl.innerHTML = s.html;
2691 |             }
2692 |         }
2693 |         
2694 |         // Sync to underlying form
2695 |         let input = document.getElementById('field-' + s.name);
2696 |         if (input) {
2697 |             input.value = s.value;
2698 |             input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
2699 |         }
2700 |         
2701 |         // Live preview sync
2702 |         const previewEl = document.getElementById('preview-' + s.name);
2703 |         if (previewEl) {
2704 |             previewEl.style.left = s.x + '%';
2705 |             previewEl.style.top  = s.y + '%';
2706 |         }
2707 |     });
2708 | }

2712 | baseLayouts.forEach(f => {
2713 |     // Convert percent string like "10%" to number 10

2715 |     const py = parseFloat((f.y || '10%').replace('%',''));
2716 |     calibPositions[f.name] = { x: px, y: py, w: f.w || '40%', h: f.h || 'auto', locked: !!f.locked };
2717 | });

2719 | function openCalibration() {
2720 |     const overlay = document.getElementById('calibrationOverlay');
2721 |     const paper   = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2722 | 
2723 |     // Clear old boxes
2724 |     paper.querySelectorAll('.calib-field').forEach(el => el.remove());
2725 |     calibHistory = []; // Reset undo stack
2726 | 
2727 |     // First show the overlay so the paper has a real rendered size
2728 |     overlay.classList.add('active');
2729 |     document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
2730 | 
2731 |     // Use requestAnimationFrame so the DOM has laid out before we measure
2732 |     requestAnimationFrame(function() {
2733 |         const paperW = paper.offsetWidth;
2734 |         const paperH = paper.offsetHeight;
2735 | 
2736 |         // Build a draggable box for each field
2737 |         baseLayouts.forEach(function(f) {
2738 |             const name  = f.name;
2739 |             const el    = document.getElementById('field-' + name);
2740 |             const value = el ? (el.value || el.textContent || '') : (f.default || f.label || name);
2741 |             const displayText = (value && value.trim()) ? value.trim() : ('[ ' + (f.label || name) + ' ]');
2742 | 
2743 |             const pos = calibPositions[name];
2744 |             // Convert saved % positions → pixels in the actual rendered paper
2745 |             const xPx = (pos.x / 100) * paperW;
2746 |             const yPx = (pos.y / 100) * paperH;
2747 |             const wPx = pos.w && pos.w !== 'auto' ? (parseFloat(pos.w) / 100) * paperW : 140;
2748 | 
2749 |             const box = document.createElement('div');
2750 |             box.className    = 'calib-field';
2751 |             box.dataset.name = name;
2752 |             box.dataset.locked = f.locked ? 'true' : 'false';
2753 |             box.style.left   = xPx + 'px';
2754 |             box.style.top    = yPx + 'px';
2755 |             box.style.width  = wPx + 'px';
2756 |             
2757 |             
2758 |             // Inner text container to protect resizers/drag-handles from getting overridden!
2759 |             const textEl = document.createElement('div');
2760 |             textEl.className = 'calib-field-text';
2761 |             textEl.contentEditable = 'true';
2762 |             textEl.style.width = '100%';
2763 |             textEl.style.height = '100%';
2764 |             textEl.style.outline = 'none';
2765 |             textEl.innerHTML = displayText;
2766 | 
2767 |             // Live sync back to inputs
2768 |             textEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
2769 |                 const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + name);
2770 |                 if (targetInput) {
2771 |                     targetInput.value = this.textContent;
2772 |                     // Trigger input event to update forms preview as well
2773 |                     targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
2774 |                 }
2775 |             });
2776 |             
2777 |             textEl.addEventListener('blur', pushCalibState);
2778 |             
2779 |             box.appendChild(textEl);
2780 | 
2781 |             // Label tag above box showing field name
2782 |             const tag = document.createElement('span');
2783 |             tag.className   = 'calib-label-tag';
2784 |             tag.textContent = f.label || name;
2785 |             tag.contentEditable = 'false';
2786 |             box.appendChild(tag);
2787 |             
2788 |             // Drag handle to move the box
2789 |             const handle = document.createElement('div');
2790 |             handle.className = 'calib-drag-handle';
2791 |             handle.innerHTML = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M5 9l-3 3 3 3M9 5l3-3 3 3M19 9l3 3-3 3M9 19l3 3 3-3M2 12h20M12 2v20"/></svg>';
2792 |             handle.contentEditable = 'false';
2793 |             box.appendChild(handle);
2794 | 
2795 |             // Setup Custom Resizer
2796 |             const resizer = document.createElement('div');
2797 |             resizer.className = 'calib-resize-handle';
2798 |             resizer.contentEditable = 'false';
2799 |             box.appendChild(resizer);
2800 | 
2801 |             makeDraggable(box, handle);
2802 |             makeResizable(box, resizer);
2803 |             
2804 |             paper.appendChild(box);
2805 |         });
2806 |         
2807 |         // Initial state capture
2808 |         pushCalibState();
2809 |     });
