2819 | function makeDraggable(el, handle) {
2820 |     if (el.dataset.locked === 'true') return;
2821 |     const paper   = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2822 |     const readout = document.getElementById('calibReadout');
2823 | 
2824 |     handle.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
2825 |         // Only respond to left-button clicks
2826 |         if (e.button !== 0) return;
2827 |         e.preventDefault();
2828 |         e.stopPropagation();
2829 | 
2830 |         el.classList.add('dragging');
2831 |         readout.style.display = 'block';
2832 | 
2833 |         // Capture how far inside the element the user clicked.
2834 |         // This prevents the box from "jumping" to have its corner at the cursor.
2835 |         const elRect    = el.getBoundingClientRect();
2836 |         const clickOffX = e.clientX - elRect.left;
2837 |         const clickOffY = e.clientY - elRect.top;
2838 | 
2839 |         function onMove(e) {
2840 |             // Get the paper's current screen position on every move.
2841 |             // This stays accurate even when the calibration body is scrolled.
2842 |             const paperRect = paper.getBoundingClientRect();
2843 |             const paperW    = paper.offsetWidth;   // actual rendered width
2844 |             const paperH    = paper.offsetHeight;  // actual rendered height
2845 | 
2846 |             // Desired top-left of the element in paper-local pixels
2847 |             let newL = e.clientX - paperRect.left - clickOffX;
2848 |             let newT = e.clientY - paperRect.top  - clickOffY;
2849 | 
2850 |             // Clamp so the element stays fully inside the paper
2851 |             newL = Math.max(0, Math.min(paperW  - el.offsetWidth,  newL));
2852 |             newT = Math.max(0, Math.min(paperH  - el.offsetHeight, newT));
2853 | 
2854 |             // Convert px → % using the ACTUAL rendered paper size
2855 |             const xPct = ((newL / paperW) * 100).toFixed(2);
2856 |             const yPct = ((newT / paperH) * 100).toFixed(2);
2857 | 
2858 |             el.style.left = xPct + '%';
2859 |             el.style.top  = yPct + '%';
2860 | 
2861 |             // Update readout
2862 |             readout.textContent = '📍 ' + el.dataset.name
2863 |                 + '   x: ' + xPct + '%'
2864 |                 + '   y: ' + yPct + '%';
2865 | 
2866 |             // Keep calibPositions in sync
2867 |             calibPositions[el.dataset.name].x = parseFloat(xPct);
2868 |             calibPositions[el.dataset.name].y = parseFloat(yPct);
2869 | 
2870 |             // Mirror to the live preview panel in real-time
2871 |             const previewEl = document.getElementById('preview-' + el.dataset.name);
2872 |             if (previewEl) {
2873 |                 previewEl.style.left = xPct + '%';
2874 |                 previewEl.style.top  = yPct + '%';
2875 |             }
2876 |         }
2877 | 
2878 |         function onUp() {
2879 |             el.classList.remove('dragging');
2880 |             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
2881 |             document.removeEventListener('mouseup',   onUp);
2882 |             setTimeout(function() { readout.style.display = 'none'; }, 2000);
2883 |             pushCalibState(); // Save state after drag
2884 |         }
2885 | 
2886 |         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
2887 |         document.addEventListener('mouseup',   onUp);
2888 |     });
2889 | }
2890 | 
2891 | function makeResizable(el, resizer) {
2892 |     if (el.dataset.locked === 'true') return;
2893 |     const paper = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2894 | 
2895 |     resizer.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
2896 |         if (e.button !== 0) return;
2897 |         e.preventDefault();
2898 |         e.stopPropagation();
2899 | 
2900 |         const startX = e.clientX;
2901 |         const startY = e.clientY;
2902 |         const startWidth = parseInt(document.defaultView.getComputedStyle(el).width, 10);
2903 |         const startHeight = parseInt(document.defaultView.getComputedStyle(el).height, 10);
2904 | 
2905 |         function onResizeMove(e) {
2906 |             const paperRect = paper.getBoundingClientRect();
2907 |             // Constraint inside paper bounds
2908 |             let newWidth = startWidth + (e.clientX - startX);
2909 |             let newHeight = startHeight + (e.clientY - startY);
2910 |             
2911 |             // Min sizes
2912 |             if (newWidth < 40) newWidth = 40;
2913 |             if (newHeight < 20) newHeight = 20;
2914 | 
2915 |             // Maximum allowed
2916 |             const maxW = paperRect.width - el.offsetLeft;
2917 |             const maxH = paperRect.height - el.offsetTop;
2918 |             
2919 |             if (newWidth > maxW) newWidth = maxW;
2920 |             if (newHeight > maxH) newHeight = maxH;
2921 | 
2922 |             // Convert to % for responsiveness
2923 |             const wPct = ((newWidth / paperRect.width) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2924 |             const hPct = ((newHeight / paperRect.height) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2925 | 
2926 |             el.style.width = wPct;
2927 |             el.style.height = hPct;
2928 | 
2929 |             if (calibPositions[name]) {
2930 |                 calibPositions[name].w = wPct;
2931 |                 calibPositions[name].h = hPct;
2932 |             }
2933 |         }
2934 | 
2935 |         function onResizeUp() {
2936 |             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
2937 |             document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onResizeUp);
2938 |             if (calibPositions[name]) {
2939 |                 calibPositions[name].w = el.style.width;
2940 |                 calibPositions[name].h = el.style.height;
2941 |             }
2942 |             pushCalibState();
2943 |         }
2944 | 
2945 |         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
2946 |         document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeUp);
2947 |     });
2948 | }

2951 | function saveCalibration() {
2952 |     const btn = document.getElementById('calibSaveBtn');
2953 |     btn.textContent = 'Saving...';
2954 |     btn.disabled    = true;
2955 | 
2956 |     // Build positions payload: name → { x: "12.5%", y: "22.1%", w, h }
2957 |     const positions = {};
2958 |     Object.entries(calibPositions).forEach(([name, pos]) => {
2959 |         const xVal = typeof pos.x === 'number' ? pos.x.toFixed(2) + '%' : pos.x;
2960 |         const yVal = typeof pos.y === 'number' ? pos.y.toFixed(2) + '%' : pos.y;
2961 |         const wVal = pos.w || '40%';
2962 |         const hVal = pos.h || 'auto';
2963 |         positions[name] = {
2964 |             x: xVal,
2965 |             y: yVal,
2966 |             w: wVal,
2967 |             h: hVal,
2968 |         };
2969 |     });
2970 | 
2971 |     const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content;
2972 | 
2973 |     // Build content payload to save document data to database
2974 |     const contentToSave = {};
2975 |     document.querySelectorAll('[id^="field-"]').forEach(el => {
2976 |         const n = el.id.replace('field-', '');
2977 |         contentToSave[n] = el.value || el.textContent || '';
2978 |     });
2979 | 
2980 |     fetch('{{ route("documents.save-layout") }}', {
2981 |         method: 'POST',
2982 |         headers: {
2983 |             'Content-Type': 'application/json',
2984 |             'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken,
2985 |             'Accept': 'application/json',
2986 |         },
2987 |         body: JSON.stringify({
2988 |             document_type: '{{ $type }}',
2989 |             case_id: '{{ $case->id ?? "" }}',
2990 |             positions: positions,
2991 |             content: contentToSave,
2992 |         }),
2993 |     })
2994 |     .then(r => r.json())
2995 |     .then(data => {
2996 |         btn.textContent = 'Save Positions';
2997 |         btn.disabled    = false;
2998 | 
2999 |         if (data.success) {
3000 |             showCalibToast();
3001 |             // Update the live preview overlay positions, width, and font styling to match
3002 |             Object.entries(positions).forEach(([name, pos]) => {
3003 |                 const previewEl = document.getElementById('preview-' + name);
3004 |                 if (previewEl) {
3005 |                     previewEl.style.left = pos.x;
3006 |                     previewEl.style.top  = pos.y;
3007 |                     if (pos.w) previewEl.style.width = pos.w;
3008 |                     if (pos.font_family) previewEl.style.fontFamily = "'" + pos.font_family + "', Arial, sans-serif";
3009 |                     if (pos.font_size) previewEl.style.fontSize = pos.font_size;
3010 |                 }
3011 |             });
3012 |             setTimeout(() => {
3013 |                 closeCalibration();
3014 |             }, 800);
3015 |         } else {
3016 |             alert('Error saving: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error'));
3017 |         }
3018 |     })
3019 |     .catch(err => {
3020 |         btn.textContent = 'Save Positions';
3021 |         btn.disabled    = false;
3022 |         alert('Network error: ' + err.message);
3023 |     });
3024 | }

3028 |     toast.classList.add('show');

3032 | function triggerAIAlign() {
3033 |     const btn = document.getElementById('aiAlignBtn');
3034 |     const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
3035 |     btn.disabled = true;
3036 |     btn.innerHTML = 'Aligning...';
3037 | 
3038 |     const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content;
3039 | 
3040 |     fetch('{{ route("documents.auto-align-ai") }}', {
3041 |         method: 'POST',
3042 |         headers: {
3043 |             'Content-Type': 'application/json',
3044 |             'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken,
3045 |             'Accept': 'application/json',
3046 |         },
3047 |         body: JSON.stringify({
3048 |             document_type: '{{ $type }}'
3049 |         }),
3050 |     })
3051 |     .then(r => r.json())
3052 |     .then(data => {
3053 |         btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
3054 |         btn.disabled = false;
3055 | 
3056 |         if (data.success && data.fields) {
3057 |             const paper = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
3058 |             const paperW = paper.offsetWidth;
3059 |             const paperH = paper.offsetHeight;
3060 | 
3061 |             data.fields.forEach(f => {
3062 |                 const name = f.name;
3063 |                 
3064 |                 // Parse coordinates
3065 |                 const px = parseFloat((f.x || '10%').replace('%',''));
3066 |                 const py = parseFloat((f.y || '10%').replace('%',''));
3067 |                 calibPositions[name] = { x: px, y: py, w: f.w || '40%', h: f.h || 'auto' };
3068 | 
3069 |                 // Update visual calib field
3070 |                 const el = document.querySelector('.calib-field[data-name="' + name + '"]');
3071 |                 if (el) {
3072 |                     el.style.left = f.x;
3073 |                     el.style.top = f.y;
3074 |                     el.style.width = f.w;
3075 |                     if (f.h && f.h !== 'auto') {
3076 |                         el.style.height = f.h;
3077 |                     }
3078 |                     
3079 |                     // Set font details if returned
3080 |                     if (f.font_family) {
3081 |                         el.style.fontFamily = "'" + f.font_family + "', sans-serif";
3082 |                     }
3083 |                     if (f.font_size) {
3084 |                         el.style.fontSize = f.font_size;
3085 |                     }
3086 |                 }
3087 | 
3088 |                 // Update live preview layout
3089 |                 const previewEl = document.getElementById('preview-' + name);
3090 |                 if (previewEl) {
3091 |                     previewEl.style.left = f.x;
3092 |                     previewEl.style.top = f.y;
3093 |                     previewEl.style.width = f.w;
3094 |                     if (f.font_family) {
3095 |                         previewEl.style.fontFamily = "'" + f.font_family + "', Arial, sans-serif";
3096 |                     }
3097 |                     if (f.font_size) {
3098 |                         previewEl.style.fontSize = f.font_size;
3099 |                     }
3100 |                 }
3101 |             });
3102 | 
3103 |             // Push state to undo stack
3104 |             pushCalibState();
3105 |             
3106 |             // Show toast message
3107 |             const toast = document.getElementById('calibToast');
3108 |             toast.innerHTML = '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/><polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/></svg> AI successfully aligned text fields!';
3109 |             toast.classList.add('show');
3110 |             setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
3111 |         } else {
3112 |             alert('AI Alignment failed: ' + (data.error || 'Check that GEMINI_API_KEY is configured in your .env file.'));
3113 |         }
3114 |     })
3115 |     .catch(err => {
3116 |         btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
3117 |         btn.disabled = false;
3118 |         alert('Network error: ' + err.message);
3119 |     });
3120 | }

 683 |         // --- Toolbar Formatting Helpers ---
 684 |         function execCmd(command, value = null) {
 685 |             document.execCommand(command, false, value);
 686 |         }
 687 | 
 688 |         function applyFontFamily(font) {
 689 |             document.execCommand('fontName', false, font);

 692 |         function increaseFontSize() {
 693 |             const numInput = document.getElementById('font-size-num');
 694 |             let val = parseInt(numInput.value) || 11;
 695 |             val += 1;
 696 |             numInput.value = val;
 697 |             setNumericFontSize(val);
 698 |         }
 699 | 
 700 |         function decreaseFontSize() {
 701 |             const numInput = document.getElementById('font-size-num');
 702 |             let val = parseInt(numInput.value) || 11;
 703 |             if (val > 6) val -= 1;
 704 |             numInput.value = val;
 705 |             setNumericFontSize(val);
 706 |         }
 707 | 
 708 |         function setNumericFontSize(val) {
 709 |             const pt = parseInt(val) || 11;
 710 |             document.execCommand('fontSize', false, '3');
 711 |             const sel = window.getSelection();
 712 |             if (sel.rangeCount > 0) {
 713 |                 const range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
 714 |                 const fontEls = range.commonAncestorContainer.parentElement ? range.commonAncestorContainer.parentElement.querySelectorAll('font[size="3"]') : [];
 715 |                 fontEls.forEach(el => {
 716 |                     el.removeAttribute('size');
 717 |                     el.style.fontSize = pt + 'pt';
 718 |                 });
 719 |             }
 720 |         }
 721 | 
 722 |         function applyPresetFontSize(preset) {
 723 |             let pt = 11;
 724 |             if (preset === 'small') pt = 9;
 725 |             if (preset === 'normal') pt = 11;
 726 |             if (preset === 'large') pt = 14;
 727 |             if (preset === 'huge') pt = 18;
 728 |             const numInput = document.getElementById('font-size-num');
 729 |             if (numInput) numInput.value = pt;
 730 |             setNumericFontSize(pt);
 731 |         }

 737 |                 canvas.style.transformOrigin = 'top center';
 738 |             }
 739 |         }

 741 |         function triggerAIAlign() {
 742 |             const btn = document.getElementById('aiAlignBtn');
 743 |             if (!btn) return;
 744 |             const orig = btn.innerHTML;
 745 |             btn.innerHTML = '✨ Aligning...';
 746 |             btn.disabled = true;
 747 | 
 748 |             const token = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');
 749 |             fetch('/api/ai/align-layout', {
 750 |                 method: 'POST',
 751 |                 headers: {
 752 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 753 |                     'Accept': 'application/json',
 754 |                     'X-CSRF-TOKEN': token
 755 |                 },
 756 |                 body: JSON.stringify({ type: '{{ $type }}' })
 757 |             })
 758 |             .then(r => r.json())
 759 |             .then(data => {
 760 |                 btn.innerHTML = '✨ Aligned!';
 761 |                 if (data.success && data.layout) {
 762 |                     // Update field positions live if returned
 763 |                     window.location.reload();
 764 |                 } else {
 765 |                     setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = orig; btn.disabled = false; }, 1500);
 766 |                 }
 767 |             })
 768 |             .catch(() => {
 769 |                 btn.innerHTML = orig;
 770 |                 btn.disabled = false;
 771 |             });
 772 |         }

 779 |         function updateStatus() {
 780 |             const status = document.getElementById('case-status-select').value;

 782 |             const originalContent = btn.innerHTML;
 783 |

 793 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',

 797 |                 body: JSON.stringify({

 799 |                 })

 804 |                     btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-outlined text-sm">check</span> <span class="text-sm">Updated</span>';
 805 |                     btn.classList.remove('bg-blue-600', 'hover:bg-blue-700');

 809 |                     }, 1000);
 810 |                 } else {
 811 |                     alert('Error: ' + data.message);
 812 |                     throw new Error(data.message);
 813 |                 }
 814 |             })
 815 |             .catch(error => {
 816 |                 btn.innerHTML = originalContent;
 817 |                 btn.disabled = false;
 818 |                 btn.classList.remove('opacity-75', 'bg-emerald-600', 'hover:bg-emerald-700');

 841 |         // --- Form Submission ---
 842 |         function submitForm() {
 843 |             const container = document.getElementById('hidden-inputs-container');
 844 |             container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous
 845 | 
 846 |             if (caseId && caseId !== 'null') {
 847 |                 const caseInput = document.createElement('input');
 848 |                 caseInput.type = 'hidden';
 849 |                 caseInput.name = 'case_id';
 850 |                 caseInput.value = caseId;
 851 |                 container.appendChild(caseInput);
 852 |             }
 853 | 
 854 |             const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.doc-field');
 855 |             const parent = document.getElementById('page-canvas');
 856 |             const parentW = parent.offsetWidth;
 857 |             const parentH = parent.offsetHeight;
 858 | 
 859 |             let overrides = {};
 860 | 
 861 |             fields.forEach(field => {
 862 |                 const name = field.getAttribute('data-name');
 863 |                 const value = field.innerText.trim(); // Trim whitespace
 864 | 
 865 |                 // Create hidden input for value
 866 |                 const input = document.createElement('input');
 867 |                 input.type = 'hidden';
 868 |                 input.name = name;
 869 |                 input.value = value;
 870 |                 container.appendChild(input);
 871 | 
 872 |                 // Use explicit stored attributes unless in layout mode
 873 |                 let x = field.getAttribute('data-x');
 874 |                 let y = field.getAttribute('data-y');
 875 |                 let w = field.getAttribute('data-w');
 876 |                 let h = field.getAttribute('data-h') || 'auto';
 877 | 
 878 |                 if (!x || isLayoutMode) {
 879 |                     x = (field.offsetLeft / parentW * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 880 |                 }
 881 |                 if (!y || isLayoutMode) {
 882 |                     y = (field.offsetTop / parentH * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 883 |                 }
 884 |                 if (!w || isLayoutMode) {
 885 |                     w = (field.offsetWidth / parentW * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 886 |                 }
 887 |                 if (isLayoutMode && field.style.height && field.style.height !== 'auto') {
 888 |                     h = (field.offsetHeight / parentH * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 889 |                 }
 890 | 
 891 |                 overrides[name] = { x, y, w, h };
 892 |             });
 893 | 
 894 |             // Store overrides in hidden input
 895 |             document.getElementById('layout-overrides').value = JSON.stringify(overrides);
 896 | 
 897 |             document.getElementById('doc-form').submit();
 898 |         }

1104 |         function makeDraggable(el) {
1105 |             el.onmousedown = onMouseDown;
1106 |             const rR = el.querySelector('.resizer-r');
1107 |             const rB = el.querySelector('.resizer-b');
1108 |             const rL = el.querySelector('.resizer-l');
1109 |             const rT = el.querySelector('.resizer-t');
1110 | 
1111 |             if (rR) rR.onmousedown = (e) => onResizeStart(e, 'w'); // w = width (right)
1112 |             if (rB) rB.onmousedown = (e) => onResizeStart(e, 'h'); // h = height (bottom)
1113 |             if (rL) rL.onmousedown = (e) => onResizeStart(e, 'l'); // l = left
1114 |             if (rT) rT.onmousedown = (e) => onResizeStart(e, 't'); // t = top
1115 |         }

1123 |         function disableDragAndResize() {

1126 |                 const rR = el.querySelector('.resizer-r');

1131 |                 if (rB) rB.onmousedown = null;

1137 |         // Resize State
1138 |         let resizingEl = null;
1139 |         let resizingFields = [];
1140 |         let resizeRefX, resizeRefY, resizeMode;
1141 | 
1142 |         function onResizeStart(e, mode) {
1143 |             if (!isLayoutMode) return;
1144 |             
1145 |             const clickedField = e.currentTarget.parentElement;
1146 |             if (clickedField.getAttribute('data-locked') === 'true') return;
1147 | 
1148 |             e.preventDefault();
1149 |             e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent drag
1150 | 
1151 |             resizingEl = clickedField;
1152 |             resizeMode = mode;
1153 |             resizeRefX = e.clientX;
1154 |             resizeRefY = e.clientY;
1155 | 
1156 |             // Make sure the clicked field is part of the selection.
1157 |             if (!selectedEls.includes(resizingEl)) {
1158 |                 selectField(resizingEl, false);
1159 |             }
1160 | 
1161 |             resizingFields = [];
1162 |             selectedEls.forEach(el => {
1163 |                 if (el.getAttribute('data-locked') !== 'true') {
1164 |                     resizingFields.push({
1165 |                         el: el,
1166 |                         startW: el.offsetWidth,
1167 |                         startH: el.offsetHeight,
1168 |                         startLeft: el.offsetLeft,
1169 |                         startTop: el.offsetTop
1170 |                     });
1171 |                 }
1172 |             });
1173 | 
1174 |             document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
1175 |             document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeEnd);
1176 |         }
1177 | 
1178 |         function onResizeMove(e) {
1179 |             if (!resizingEl || resizingFields.length === 0) return;
1180 |             e.preventDefault();
1181 | 
1182 |             const dx = e.clientX - resizeRefX;
1183 |             const dy = e.clientY - resizeRefY;
1184 | 
1185 |             resizingFields.forEach(item => {
1186 |                 if (resizeMode === 'w') {
1187 |                     item.el.style.width = (item.startW + dx) + 'px';
1188 |                 } else if (resizeMode === 'h') {
1189 |                     item.el.style.height = (item.startH + dy) + 'px';
1190 |                 } else if (resizeMode === 'l') {
1191 |                     item.el.style.width = (item.startW - dx) + 'px';
1192 |                     item.el.style.left = (item.startLeft + dx) + 'px';
1193 |                 } else if (resizeMode === 't') {
1194 |                     item.el.style.height = (item.startH - dy) + 'px';
1195 |                     item.el.style.top = (item.startTop + dy) + 'px';
1196 |                 }
1197 |             });
1198 |         }
1199 | 
1200 |         function updateFieldDataPos(el) {
1201 |             const parent = document.getElementById('page-canvas');
1202 |             if (!parent) return;
1203 |             const parentW = parent.offsetWidth;
1204 |             const parentH = parent.offsetHeight;
1205 |             if (parentW && parentH) {
1206 |                 const x = ((el.offsetLeft / parentW) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1207 |                 const y = ((el.offsetTop / parentH) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1208 |                 const w = ((el.offsetWidth / parentW) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1209 |                 let h = 'auto';
1210 |                 if (el.style.height && el.style.height !== 'auto') {
1211 |                     h = ((el.offsetHeight / parentH) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1212 |                 }
1213 |                 el.setAttribute('data-x', x);
1214 |                 el.setAttribute('data-y', y);
1215 |                 el.setAttribute('data-w', w);
1216 |                 el.setAttribute('data-h', h);
1217 |             }
1218 |         }
1219 | 
1220 |         function onResizeEnd() {
1221 |             if (resizingFields.length > 0) {
1222 |                 resizingFields.forEach(item => {
1223 |                     updateFieldDataPos(item.el);
1224 |                 });
1225 |             }
1226 |             resizingEl = null;
1227 |             resizingFields = [];
1228 |             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
1229 |             document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onResizeEnd);
1230 |         }

1232 |         // Draggable State
1233 |         let draggedEl = null;
1234 |         let draggedFields = [];
1235 |         let startX, startY;
1236 | 
1237 |         function onMouseDown(e) {
1238 |             if (!isLayoutMode) return;
1239 | 
1240 |             // Ignore if clicking on resizers
1241 |             if (e.target.classList.contains('resizer-r') ||
1242 |                 e.target.classList.contains('resizer-b') ||
1243 |                 e.target.classList.contains('resizer-l') ||
1244 |                 e.target.classList.contains('resizer-t')) return;
1245 | 
1246 |             // Prevent default to stop text selection or focus
1247 |             e.preventDefault();
1248 | 
1249 |             const clickedEl = e.currentTarget;
1250 | 
1251 |             // Toggle/append with Ctrl key
1252 |             if (e.ctrlKey) {
1253 |                 selectField(clickedEl, true);
1254 |             } else {
1255 |                 if (!selectedEls.includes(clickedEl)) {
1256 |                     selectField(clickedEl, false);
1257 |                 }
1258 |             }
1259 | 
1260 |             // Locked fields cannot be dragged
1261 |             if (clickedEl.getAttribute('data-locked') === 'true') {
1262 |                 return;
1263 |             }
1264 | 
1265 |             draggedEl = clickedEl;
1266 |             startX = e.clientX;
1267 |             startY = e.clientY;
1268 | 
1269 |             // Collect starting positions for all selected, unlocked fields
1270 |             draggedFields = [];
1271 |             selectedEls.forEach(el => {
1272 |                 if (el.getAttribute('data-locked') !== 'true') {
1273 |                     el.style.zIndex = 1000; // Bring to front during drag
1274 |                     draggedFields.push({
1275 |                         el: el,
1276 |                         startLeft: el.offsetLeft,
1277 |                         startTop: el.offsetTop
1278 |                     });
1279 |                 }
1280 |             });
1281 | 
1282 |             document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
1283 |             document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
1284 |         }
1285 | 
1286 |         function onMouseMove(e) {
1287 |             if (!draggedEl || draggedFields.length === 0) return;
1288 |             e.preventDefault();
1289 |             const dx = e.clientX - startX;
1290 |             const dy = e.clientY - startY;
1291 | 
1292 |             draggedFields.forEach(item => {
1293 |                 item.el.style.left = (item.startLeft + dx) + 'px';
1294 |                 item.el.style.top = (item.startTop + dy) + 'px';
1295 |             });
1296 |         }
1297 | 
1298 |         function onMouseUp() {
1299 |             if (draggedFields.length > 0) {
1300 |                 draggedFields.forEach(item => {
1301 |                     item.el.style.zIndex = ''; // Reset z-index
1302 |                     updateFieldDataPos(item.el);
1303 |                 });
1304 |             }
1305 |             draggedEl = null;
1306 |             draggedFields = [];
1307 |             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
1308 |             document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
1309 |         }

1313 |             // Gather all data, including dynamic fields
1314 |             const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.doc-field');

1316 | 
1317 |             fields.forEach(el => {

1319 |                 const type = el.getAttribute('data-type');

1321 |

1323 |                 if (key === 'case_no') key = 'case_no';
1324 |                 if (key === 'complainant') key = 'complainant';
1325 |                 if (key === 'respondent') key = 'respondent';
1326 |                 // ... map others or trust frontend names match backend validation
1327 | 
1328 |                 let value = el.innerText.trim();
1329 |                 if (type === 'checkbox') {
1330 |                     value = el.innerText.trim() === 'X' ? 1 : 0;
1331 |                 }
1332 |                 formData[name] = value;
1333 |             });
1334 | 
1335 |             // Add document type for nature of case
1336 |             formData['document_type'] = document.querySelector('input[name="type"]').value;
1337 | 
1338 |             // Capture Layout Overrides (Positions)
1339 |             const overrides = {};
1340 |             const parent = document.getElementById('field-layer');
1341 |             const parentW = parent.offsetWidth;
1342 |             const parentH = parent.offsetHeight;
1343 | 
1344 |             fields.forEach(el => {
1345 |                 const name = el.getAttribute('data-name');
1346 |                 const x = (el.offsetLeft / parentW * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1347 |                 const y = (el.offsetTop / parentH * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1348 |                 const w = (el.offsetWidth / parentW * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1349 |                 let h = 'auto';
1350 |                 if (el.style.height && el.style.height !== 'auto') {
1351 |                     h = (el.offsetHeight / parentH * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1352 |                 }
1353 |                 overrides[name] = { x, y, w, h };
1354 |             });
1355 |             formData['layout_overrides'] = overrides;

1360 |             if (!formData['complainant']) console.warn('Warning: complainant is missing');

1362 | 
1363 |             const btn = document.querySelector('#btn-submit-case');

1365 |

1369 | 
1370 |             btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-outlined animate-spin">refresh</span> ' + (isUpdate ? 'Updating...' : 'Submitting...');

1372 |             btn.classList.add('opacity-75');

1375 | 
1376 |             fetch(url, {
1377 |                 method: method,
1378 |                 headers: {
1379 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
1380 |                     'Accept': 'application/json',
1381 |                     'X-CSRF-TOKEN': token
1382 |                 },
1383 |                 body: JSON.stringify(formData)
1384 |             })
1385 |                 .then(response => response.json())
1386 |                 .then(data => {
1387 |                     if (data.success) {
1388 |                         btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-outlined">check</span> ' + (isUpdate ? 'Updated' : 'Submitted');
1389 |                         btn.classList.remove('bg-[#0F8C55]', 'hover:bg-[#0D7A4A]');
1390 |                         btn.classList.add('bg-gray-500', 'cursor-default');

1393 |

1395 |                         setTimeout(() => {
1396 |                             if (isUpdate) {
1397 |                                 // Reload to view mode (remove edit query param)
1398 |                                 window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
1399 |                             } else {
1400 |                                 // Optional: Redirect to cases index or dashboard?
1401 |                                 // window.location.href = '/cases'; 
1402 |                             }
1403 |                         }, 1000);
1404 |                     } else {

1407 |                 })

1411 |

1418 |         }

1422 |             const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.doc-field');

1424 |             const parentW = parent.offsetWidth;

1429 |                 const name = el.getAttribute('data-name');
1430 |                 const label = el.getAttribute('placeholder');
1431 | 
1432 |                 // Convert px to %
1433 |                 const x = (el.offsetLeft / parentW * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
1434 |                 const y = (el.offsetTop / parentH * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
1435 |                 const w = (el.offsetWidth / parentW * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';

1437 |

1444 |                 let typeStr = el.style.height !== 'auto' && parseInt(el.style.height) > 30 ? ", 'type' => 'textarea'" : "";
1445 |                 let lockedStr = el.getAttribute('data-locked') === 'true' ? ", 'locked' => true" : "";
1446 | 
1447 |                 output += `    ['name' => '${name}', 'label' => '${label}', 'x' => '${x}', 'y' => '${y}', 'w' => '${w}', 'h' => '${h}'${classStr}${typeStr}${lockedStr}],\n`;
1448 |             });
1449 |             output += "]";
1450 | 
1451 |             // Copy to clipboard
1452 |             navigator.clipboard.writeText(output).then(() => {
1453 |                 alert("PHP Array Configuration copied to clipboard! Paste it into FormLayouts.php");
1454 |             });
1455 |             console.log(output);
1456 |         }

1458 |         function saveLayout() {
1459 |             const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.doc-field');
1460 |             const layout = [];
1461 |             const container = document.getElementById('page-canvas');
1462 | 
1463 |             // Use getBoundingClientRect for more accurate relative positioning
1464 |             const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
1465 |             const parentW = containerRect.width;
1466 |             const parentH = containerRect.height;
1467 | 
1468 |             if (parentW === 0 || parentH === 0) {
1469 |                 alert('Error: Canvas dimensions are zero. Cannot save layout.');
1470 |                 return;
1471 |             }
1472 | 
1473 |             fields.forEach(field => {
1474 |                 const fieldRect = field.getBoundingClientRect();
1475 |                 const name = field.getAttribute('data-name');
1476 | 
1477 |                 // Calculate relative position based on viewport rects
1478 |                 const relativeLeft = fieldRect.left - containerRect.left;
1479 |                 const relativeTop = fieldRect.top - containerRect.top;
1480 | 
1481 |                 const x = (relativeLeft / parentW * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1482 |                 const y = (relativeTop / parentH * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1483 |                 const w = (fieldRect.width / parentW * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1484 | 
1485 |                 let h = field.style.height;
1486 |                 if (!h || h === 'auto') {
1487 |                     if (field.style.height && field.style.height !== 'auto') {
1488 |                         h = field.style.height;
1489 |                     } else {
1490 |                         h = 'auto';
1491 |                     }
1492 |                 } else if (h.includes('px')) {
1493 |                     h = (parseFloat(h) / parentH * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1494 |                 }
1495 | 
1496 |                 layout.push({
1497 |                     name: name,
1498 |                     x: x,
1499 |                     y: y,
1500 |                     w: w,

   8 | // --- FRONTEND SABOTAGE TRACKER (Audit Trail Logger) ---
   9 | // Catches crashes when React code is maliciously deleted, pushes them directly to Database Audit Log!
  10 | window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
  11 |     const errorFile = event.filename ? `File: ${event.filename}:${event.lineno}` : `Page: ${window.location.href}`;
  12 |     const stackTrace = event.error?.stack ? ` | Trace: ${event.error.stack.split('\n')[1]?.trim()}` : '';
  13 |     
  14 |     fetch('/api/system-error', {
  15 |         method: 'POST',
  16 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  17 |         body: JSON.stringify({ message: event.message + stackTrace, url: errorFile })
  18 |     }).catch(() => {});
  19 | });
  20 | window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
  21 |     fetch('/api/system-error', {
  22 |         method: 'POST',
  23 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  24 |         body: JSON.stringify({ message: event.reason?.message || 'Unhandled Promise Crash', url: window.location.href })
  25 |     }).catch(() => {});
  26 | });
  27 | // ------------------------------------------------------

 212 |         if (diffDays > 7) return null; // Show tag only for cases filed in the last 7 days
 213 | 
 214 |         if (diffHours < 1) return 'Added just now';
 215 |         if (diffHours < 24) return `Added ${diffHours}h ago`;
 216 |         if (diffDays === 1) return 'Filed Yesterday';
 217 |         return `Filed ${diffDays}d ago`;
 218 |     };
 219 | 
 220 |     // Filter & sort modal cases chronologically (most recent first)
 221 |     const filteredModalCases = latestMonthCases
 222 |         .filter((c) => {
 223 |             // Month filter
 224 |             if (modalMonth !== 'all') {
 225 |                 const d = new Date(c.raw_date_filed || c.date_filed);
 226 |                 if (isNaN(d.getTime()) || String(d.getMonth() + 1) !== modalMonth) {
 227 |                     return false;
 228 |                 }
 229 |             }
 230 |             // Status filter
 231 |             if (modalStatus !== 'all' && c.status?.toLowerCase() !== modalStatus.toLowerCase()) {
 232 |                 return false;
 233 |             }
 234 |             // Search query
 235 |             if (modalSearch.trim() !== '') {
 236 |                 const q = modalSearch.toLowerCase();
 237 |                 const matchNo = c.case_number?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 238 |                 const matchComp = c.complainant?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 239 |                 const matchResp = c.respondent?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 240 |                 const matchType = c.type?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 241 |                 return matchNo || matchComp || matchResp || matchType;
 242 |             }
 243 |             return true;
 244 |         })
 245 |         .sort((a, b) => {
 246 |             const timeA = new Date(a.raw_date_filed || a.date_filed).getTime();
 247 |             const timeB = new Date(b.raw_date_filed || b.date_filed).getTime();
 248 |             return timeB - timeA;
 249 |         });
 250 |

 253 |             <Head title="Dashboard" />
 254 | 
 255 |             <div className="flex-1 space-y-6 p-4 md:p-8 pt-6 text-secondary/80 dark:text-secondary">
 256 |

 263 |                         </p>
 264 |                     </div>

 116 | function formatDateWithoutShift(dateStr?: string | null) {
 117 |     if (!dateStr) return 'N/A';
 118 |     const cleanDate = dateStr.split('T')[0];
 119 |     const parts = cleanDate.split('-');
 120 |     if (parts.length === 3 && parts[0].length === 4) {
 121 |         const year = Number(parts[0]);
 122 |         const month = Number(parts[1]) - 1;
 123 |         const day = Number(parts[2]);
 124 |         const localDate = new Date(year, month, day);
 125 |         return localDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
 126 |     }
 127 |     const d = new Date(dateStr);
 128 |     return !isNaN(d.getTime()) ? d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' }) : dateStr;
 129 | }
 130 | 
 131 | function normalizeDateToISO(val: string): string {
 132 |     if (!val) return '';
 133 |     if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(val)) return val;
 134 |     const parts = val.split(/[\/\-]/);
 135 |     if (parts.length === 3) {
 136 |         if (parts[2].length === 4) {
 137 |             const m = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
 138 |             const d = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
 139 |             const y = parts[2];
 140 |             return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
 141 |         } else if (parts[0].length === 4) {
 142 |             const y = parts[0];
 143 |             const m = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
 144 |             const d = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
 145 |             return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
 146 |         }
 147 |     }
 148 |     return val;
 149 | }

  16 | function debounce(func: Function, wait: number) {
  17 |     let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout;
  18 |     return function (...args: any[]) {
  19 |         clearTimeout(timeout);
  20 |         timeout = setTimeout(() => func(...args), wait);
  21 |     };
  22 | }

 114 |             setQuickAddLabel('');

 116 |             addField('text');
 117 |         }
 118 |     };
 119 | 
 120 |     const removeField = (id: string) => syncFields(fields.filter(f => f.id !== id));
 121 | 
 122 |     const moveField = (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number) => {
 123 |         if (toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= fields.length) return;
 124 |         const updated = [...fields];
 125 |         const [moved] = updated.splice(fromIndex, 1);
 126 |         updated.splice(toIndex, 0, moved);
 127 |         syncFields(updated);
 128 |     };
 129 | 
 130 |     const handleDragStart = (index: number) => (e: React.DragEvent) => {
 131 |         setDragIndex(index);
 132 |         e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
 133 |         e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(index));
 134 |         // Make the drag image slightly transparent
 135 |         if (e.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement) {
 136 |             e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '0.5';
 137 |         }
 138 |     };
 139 | 
 140 |     const handleDragEnd = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
 141 |         if (e.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement) {
 142 |             e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '1';
 143 |         }
 144 |         setDragIndex(null);
 145 |         setDragOverIndex(null);
 146 |     };
 147 | 
 148 |     const handleDragOver = (index: number) => (e: React.DragEvent) => {
 149 |         e.preventDefault();
 150 |         e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
 151 |         setDragOverIndex(index);
 152 |     };
 153 | 
 154 |     const handleDrop = (toIndex: number) => (e: React.DragEvent) => {
 155 |         e.preventDefault();
 156 |         const fromIndex = Number(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
 157 |         if (!isNaN(fromIndex) && fromIndex !== toIndex) {
 158 |             moveField(fromIndex, toIndex);
 159 |         }
 160 |         setDragIndex(null);
 161 |         setDragOverIndex(null);
 162 |     };
 163 | 
 164 |     const updateLabel = (id: string, label: string) =>
 165 |         syncFields(fields.map(f => f.id === id ? { ...f, label } : f));
 166 | 
 167 |     const updatePlaceholder = (id: string, placeholder: string) =>
 168 |         syncFields(fields.map(f => f.id === id ? { ...f, placeholder } : f));
 169 | 
 170 |     const toggleRequired = (id: string) =>
 171 |         syncFields(fields.map(f => f.id === id ? { ...f, required: !f.required } : f));
 172 | 
 173 |     const handleFileDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
 174 |         e.preventDefault();
 175 |         setDragOver(false);
 176 |         const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
 177 |         if (file?.type === 'application/pdf') setData('pdf', file);
 178 |     };
 179 | 
 180 |     const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState(false);
 181 | 
 182 |     const autofillCommonFields = async () => {
 183 |         if (!data.pdf) return;
 184 | 
 185 |         setIsScanning(true);
 186 |         try {
 187 |             const arrayBuffer = await data.pdf.arrayBuffer();
 188 |             const pdf = await pdfjs.getDocument({ data: arrayBuffer }).promise;
 189 | 
 190 |             let detectedText = "";
 191 |             const numPages = Math.min(pdf.numPages, 2);
 192 |             for (let i = 1; i <= numPages; i++) {
 193 |                 const page = await pdf.getPage(i);
 194 |                 const textContent = await page.getTextContent();
 195 |                 detectedText += textContent.items.map((item: any) => item.str).join(" ") + " ";
 196 |             }
 197 | 
 198 |             const coreFields: FormField[] = [
 199 |                 { id: 'case_no', type: 'text', label: 'Case Number', required: true },
 200 |                 { id: 'complainant', type: 'text', label: 'Complainant Name', required: true },
 201 |                 { id: 'respondent', type: 'text', label: 'Respondent Name', required: true },
 202 |                 { id: 'made_this_day', type: 'text', label: 'Day', required: true },
 203 |                 { id: 'made_this_month', type: 'text', label: 'Month', required: true },
 204 |                 { id: 'made_this_year', type: 'text', label: 'Year', required: true },
 205 |             ];
 206 | 
 207 |             const newFields: FormField[] = [];
 208 |             const addedLabels = new Set(fields.map(f => f.label.toLowerCase()));
 209 | 
 210 |             const checkAndAdd = (label: string, id: string, type: FieldType = 'text') => {
 211 |                 if (!addedLabels.has(label.toLowerCase())) {
 212 |                     newFields.push({ id, type, label, required: true });
 213 |                     addedLabels.add(label.toLowerCase());
 214 |                 }
 215 |             };
 216 | 
 217 |             coreFields.forEach(cf => checkAndAdd(cf.label, cf.id, cf.type));
 218 | 
 219 |             if (detectedText.match(/Nature of/i) || detectedText.match(/For:/i)) checkAndAdd('Nature of Case', 'For');
 220 |             if (detectedText.match(/Hearing/i)) checkAndAdd('Hearing Date/Time', 'hearing_info', 'date');
 221 | 
 222 |             const fieldPatterns = [
 223 |                 /([A-Z][a-zA-Z\s]{2,25})(?::|\.|\s)\s*(?:_{2,}|\.{3,})/g,
 224 |                 /([A-Z][A-Z\s]{2,20})(?::)\s*/g,
 225 |                 /([A-Z][a-z\s]{2,20})(?::)\s+/g
 226 |             ];
 227 | 
 228 |             const ignoredWords = ['The', 'This', 'Republic', 'Philippines', 'Office', 'Barangay', 'Province', 'City', 'Region', 'Lupon', 'Pangkat', 'Form'];
 229 | 
 230 |             for (const pattern of fieldPatterns) {
 231 |                 let match;
 232 |                 while ((match = pattern.exec(detectedText)) !== null) {
 233 |                     const label = match[1].trim();
 234 |                     if (label.length > 2 &&
 235 |                         !/^\d+$/.test(label) &&
 236 |                         !ignoredWords.some(w => label.toLowerCase() === w.toLowerCase())
 237 |                     ) {
 238 |                         checkAndAdd(label, label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, ''));
 239 |                     }
 240 |                     if (newFields.length > 18) break;
 241 |                 }
 242 |             }
 243 | 
 244 |             if (detectedText.match(/Signature/i) && !addedLabels.has('signature')) checkAndAdd('Signature Line', 'signature');
 245 |             if (detectedText.match(/Witness/i)) checkAndAdd('Witness Name', 'witness');
 246 | 
 247 |             syncFields([...fields, ...newFields]);
 248 |         } catch (error) {
 249 |             console.error("PDF Scan Error:", error);
 250 |             const fallback: FormField[] = [
 251 |                 { id: 'case_no', type: 'text', label: 'Case Number', required: true },
 252 |                 { id: 'complainant', type: 'text', label: 'Complainant Name', required: true },
 253 |                 { id: 'respondent', type: 'text', label: 'Respondent Name', required: true },
 254 |                 { id: 'made_this_day', type: 'text', label: 'Day', required: true },
 255 |                 { id: 'made_this_month', type: 'text', label: 'Month', required: true },
 256 |                 { id: 'made_this_year', type: 'text', label: 'Year', required: true },
 257 |             ];
 258 |             const existingLabels = new Set(fields.map(f => f.label.toLowerCase()));
 259 |             const toAdd = fallback.filter(f => !existingLabels.has(f.label.toLowerCase()));
 260 |             syncFields([...fields, ...toAdd]);
 261 |         } finally {
 262 |             setIsScanning(false);
 263 |         }
 264 |     };
 265 | 
 266 |     const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 267 |         e.preventDefault();
 268 |         // If it's a standard template (id: 0), we treat it as a new creation
 269 |         if (isEdit && existingTemplate.id > 0) {
 270 |             post(`/documents/update-custom/${existingTemplate.id}`, { forceFormData: true });
 271 |         } else {
 272 |             post('/documents/store-custom', { forceFormData: true });
 273 |         }
 274 |     };
 275 | 
 276 |     return (
 277 |         <AppLayout breadcrumbs={breadcrumbs}>
 278 |             <Head title={isEdit ? `Edit Questions: ${existingTemplate.title}` : "Create Custom Template"} />
 279 | 
 280 |             <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6 pb-20 p-4">
 281 | 
 282 |                 {/* ── Header ── */}
 283 |                 <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
 284 |                     <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">{isEdit ? 'Edit Template Questions' : 'Create Custom Template'}</h1>
 285 |                     <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{isEdit ? 'Modify the questions for this document.' : 'Upload a PDF and define the questions for your answer sheet.'}</p>
 286 |                 </div>
 287 | 
 288 |                 <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12">
 289 | 
 290 |                     {/* ── Left Column: Config ── */}
 291 |                     <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
 292 |                         <Card className="shadow-sm border-border">
 293 |                             <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b bg-muted/20">
 294 |                                 <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
 295 |                                     <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
 296 |                                     Template Details
 297 |                                 </CardTitle>
 298 |                             </CardHeader>
 299 |                             <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-4">
 300 |                                 <div className="space-y-2">
 301 |                                     <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Document Title</label>
 302 |                                     <input
 303 |                                         type="text"
 304 |                                         value={data.title}
 305 |                                         onChange={e => setData('title', e.target.value)}
 306 |                                         placeholder="e.g. Barangay Clearance"
 307 |                                         className="w-full text-sm rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all"
 308 |                                     />
 309 |                                     {errors.title && <p className="text-[10px] text-red-500">{errors.title}</p>}
 310 |                                 </div>
 311 |                                 <div className="space-y-2">
 312 |                                     <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Description</label>
 313 |                                     <textarea
 314 |                                         value={data.description}
 315 |                                         onChange={e => setData('description', e.target.value)}
 316 |                                         placeholder="Brief purpose of this document…"
 317 |                                         rows={3}
 318 |                                         className="w-full text-sm rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all"
 319 |                                     />
 320 |                                 </div>
 321 |                                 <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t">
 322 |                                     <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-3 block">Template Mode</label>
 323 |                                     <div className="flex gap-2">
 324 |                                         <button
 325 |                                             type="button"
 326 |                                             onClick={() => setData('is_view_only', false)}
 327 |                                             className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all ${!data.is_view_only ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 text-primary ring-2 ring-primary/20' : 'border-border bg-background grow hover:bg-muted/50'}`}
 328 |                                         >
 329 |                                             <Edit className="h-5 w-5" />
 330 |                                             <div className="text-center">
 331 |                                                 <p className="text-xs font-bold">Editable</p>
 332 |                                                 <p className="text-[9px] opacity-70">Electronic form filling</p>
 333 |                                             </div>
 334 |                                         </button>
 335 |                                         <button
 336 |                                             type="button"
 337 |                                             onClick={() => setData('is_view_only', true)}
 338 |                                             className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all ${data.is_view_only ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 text-primary ring-2 ring-primary/20' : 'border-border bg-background grow hover:bg-muted/50'}`}
 339 |                                         >
 340 |                                             <Eye className="h-5 w-5" />
 341 |                                             <div className="text-center">
 342 |                                                 <p className="text-xs font-bold">View Only</p>
 343 |                                                 <p className="text-[9px] opacity-70">Static PDF download</p>
 344 |                                             </div>
 345 |                                         </button>
 346 |                                     </div>
 347 |                                     <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground mt-2 italic">
 348 |                                         {data.is_view_only 
 349 |                                           ? "View Only mode hides the question builder. Users will only be able to view/download the original PDF template." 
 350 |                                           : "Editable mode allows you to define questions that users will fill out digitally on top of the PDF."}
 351 |                                     </p>
 352 |                                 </div>
 353 |                                 <div className="space-y-2">
 354 |                                     <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Template Icon</label>
 355 |                                     <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
 356 |                                         {AVAILABLE_ICONS.map((iconOpt) => (
 357 |                                             <button
 358 |                                                 key={iconOpt.name}
 359 |                                                 type="button"
 360 |                                                 onClick={() => setData('icon_name', iconOpt.name)}
 361 |                                                 className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border transition-all ${data.icon_name === iconOpt.name
 362 |                                                         ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary scale-[1.02] font-bold'
 363 |                                                         : 'border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground'
 364 |                                                     }`}
 365 |                                                 title={iconOpt.label}
 366 |                                             >
 367 |                                                 <iconOpt.icon className="h-4 w-4" />
 368 |                                                 <span className="text-xs">{iconOpt.label}</span>
 369 |                                             </button>
 370 |                                         ))}
 371 |                                     </div>
 372 |                                 </div>
 373 |                             </CardContent>
 374 |                         </Card>
 375 | 
 376 |                         <Card className="shadow-sm">
 377 |                             <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b">
 378 |                                 <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
 379 |                                     <Upload className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
 380 |                                     Background PDF
 381 |                                 </CardTitle>
 382 |                             </CardHeader>
 383 |                             <CardContent className="pt-4">
 384 |                                 <div
 385 |                                     onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
 386 |                                     onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(true); }}
 387 |                                     onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
 388 |                                     onDrop={handleFileDrop}
 389 |                                     className={`
 390 |                                         relative group cursor-pointer border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl p-6 transition-all duration-200
 391 |                                         flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3
 392 |                                         ${dragOver ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'border-border hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-muted/30'}
 393 |                                         ${data.pdf ? 'border-emerald-500/50 bg-emerald-500/5' : ''}
 394 |                                     `}
 395 |                                 >
 396 |                                     <input
 397 |                                         type="file"
 398 |                                         ref={fileRef}
 399 |                                         onChange={e => e.target.files && setData('pdf', e.target.files[0])}
 400 |                                         accept=".pdf"
 401 |                                         className="hidden"
 402 |                                     />
 403 | 
 404 |                                     {data.pdf ? (
 405 |                                         <>
 406 |                                             <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-green-100 flex items-center justify-center">
 407 |                                                 <FileCheck className="h-7 w-7 text-green-600" />
 408 |                                             </div>
 409 |                                             <div className="text-center">
 410 |                                                 <p className="font-semibold text-sm text-green-700 max-w-[200px] truncate">{data.pdf.name}</p>
 411 |                                                 <p className="text-xs text-green-600/70 mt-1">Ready to upload</p>
 412 |                                             </div>
 413 |                                             <button
 414 |                                                 type="button"
 415 |                                                 onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setData('pdf', null); }}
 416 |                                                 className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-red-100 text-red-500 transition-colors"
 417 |                                             >
 418 |                                                 <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
 419 |                                             </button>
 420 |                                         </>
 421 |                                     ) : (
 422 |                                         <>
 423 |                                             <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center">
 424 |                                                 <Upload className="h-7 w-7 text-slate-400" />
 425 |                                             </div>
 426 |                                             <div className="text-center">
 427 |                                                 <p className="text-sm font-medium">Upload Background PDF</p>
 428 |                                                 <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">PDF only, max 20MB</p>
 429 |                                                 {isEdit && existingTemplate.file_path && (
 430 |                                                     <div className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-1 rounded inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
 431 |                                                         <FileCheck className="h-3 w-3" />
 432 |                                                         Has background. Upload new to replace.
 433 |                                                     </div>
 434 |                                                 )}
 435 |                                             </div>
 436 |                                         </>
 437 |                                     )}
 438 |                                 </div>
 439 | 
 440 |                                 {data.pdf && (
 441 |                                     <Button
 442 |                                         type="button"
 443 |                                         variant="outline"
 444 |                                         size="sm"
 445 |                                         className="w-full mt-4 h-10 border-dashed border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5"
 446 |                                         onClick={autofillCommonFields}
 447 |                                         disabled={isScanning}
 448 |                                     >
 449 |                                         {isScanning ? (
 450 |                                             <>Scanning Document...</>
 451 |                                         ) : (
 452 |                                             <>
 453 |                                                 <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
 454 |                                                 AI Smart Autofill Questions
 455 |                                             </>
 456 |                                         )}
 457 |                                     </Button>
 458 |                                 )}
 459 |                             </CardContent>
 460 |                         </Card>
 461 |                     </div>
 462 | 
 463 |                         {/* ── Right Column: Builder ── */}
 464 |                         <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
 465 |                             {!data.is_view_only ? (
 466 |                                 <Card className="shadow-sm border-t-4 border-t-primary border-border">
 467 |                                     <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b bg-muted/40">
 468 |                                         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 469 |                                             <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground">
 470 |                                                 <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
 471 |                                                 Build Answer Sheet
 472 |                                             </CardTitle>
 473 |                                             <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border border-slate-200 uppercase tracking-tight">
 474 |                                                 {fields.length} Answer Fields
 475 |                                             </span>
 476 |                                         </div>
 477 |                                         <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-muted/30 rounded-lg border border-border/50">
 478 |                                             <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground font-medium">
 479 |                                                 <strong>Instructions:</strong> Fill in all required fields below. Your answers will be printed directly onto the official form. Fields marked with <span className="text-red-500 font-bold">*</span> are required.
 480 |                                             </p>
 481 |                                         </div>
 482 |                                     </CardHeader>
 483 |                                     <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
 484 | 
 485 |                                 {/* Quick-Add */}
 486 |                                 <div className="space-y-4">
 487 |                                     <div className="flex gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-secondary/30 border border-border/50">
 488 |                                         <div className="relative flex-1">
 489 |                                             <input
 490 |                                                 id="quick-add-label"
 491 |                                                 type="text"
 492 |                                                 value={quickAddLabel}
 493 |                                                 onChange={(e) => setQuickAddLabel(e.target.value)}
 494 |                                                 placeholder="Quick add: Type label..."
 495 |                                                 className="w-full h-10 pl-3 pr-4 text-sm rounded-lg border-border bg-background focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all"
 496 |                                                 onKeyDown={(e) => {
 497 |                                                     if (e.key === 'Enter') {
 498 |                                                         e.preventDefault();
 499 |                                                         handleQuickAdd();
 500 |                                                     }
 501 |                                                 }}
 502 |                                             />
 503 |                                         </div>
 504 |                                         <Button
 505 |                                             type="button"
 506 |                                             size="sm"
 507 |                                             className="h-10 bg-primary px-4 shadow-sm"
 508 |                                             onClick={handleQuickAdd}
 509 |                                         >
 510 |                                             <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1.5" />
 511 |                                             Add Question
 512 |                                         </Button>
 513 |                                     </div>
 514 | 
 515 |                                     {fields.length === 0 && (
 516 |                                         <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/20">

 518 |                                             <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
 519 |                                                 <button
 520 |                                                     type="button"
 521 |                                                     onClick={() => {
 522 |                                                         const noticeFields: FormField[] = [
 523 |                                                             { id: 'complainant', type: 'text', label: 'Complainant (Full Name)', placeholder: 'Full legal name of the complainant', required: true },
 524 |                                                             { id: 'respondent', type: 'text', label: 'Respondent / Addressee', placeholder: 'Full legal name of the respondent', required: true },
 525 |                                                             { id: 'case_no', type: 'text', label: 'Case Number', placeholder: 'e.g. 26-001', required: true },

 550 |

 560 |                                                 ? 'opacity-50 border-primary/50 scale-[0.98]'

 565 |                                         >
 566 |                                             {/* Drop indicator line */}

 569 |                                             )}
 570 | 
 571 |                                             <div className="flex items-start gap-3">

 573 |                                                 <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 mt-1">
 574 |                                                     <button

 576 |                                                         onClick={() => moveField(index, index - 1)}
 577 |                                                         disabled={index === 0}
 578 |                                                         className={`p-0.5 rounded transition-colors ${index === 0
 579 |                                                             ? 'text-slate-200 cursor-not-allowed'

 592 |                                                     <button
 593 |                                                         type="button"
 594 |                                                         onClick={() => moveField(index, index + 1)}
 595 |                                                         disabled={index === fields.length - 1}
 596 |                                                         className={`p-0.5 rounded transition-colors ${index === fields.length - 1
 597 |                                                             ? 'text-slate-200 cursor-not-allowed'
 598 |                                                             : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10'
 599 |                                                             }`}
 600 |                                                         title="Move down"

  33 |     const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
